        scenePlayerView() {
            let state;
            try {
                state = this.repository.load();
            }
            catch (error) {
                return fail('STATE_READ_FAILED', messageOf(error));
            }
            if (!state)
                return fail('NO_CAMPAIGN', 'Nenhuma campanha carregada.');
            try {
                const world = state.world ?? {};
                const sceneLocationId = state.scene?.locationId ?? null;
                const locationCandidate = sceneLocationId ? world.locations?.[sceneLocationId] ?? null : null;
                const location = locationCandidate?.knownToPlayer
                    ? { id: locationCandidate.id, name: String(locationCandidate.name ?? ''), description: String(locationCandidate.description ?? '') }
                    : null;
                const participants = [];
                const seenParticipants = new Set();
                const sceneVisibleNpcIds = Array.isArray(state.scene?.visibleNpcIds) ? new Set(state.scene.visibleNpcIds.map(String)) : null;
                const sceneNarrativeText = String(state.scene?.narration ?? state.master?.narration ?? '').toLocaleLowerCase('pt-BR');
                const pushParticipant = (value) => {
                    const name = String(value?.name ?? '').trim();
                    const identityKey = value?.id ? `id:${String(value.id)}` : `name:${name.toLocaleLowerCase('pt-BR')}`;
                    if (!name || seenParticipants.has(identityKey) || participants.length >= 3)
                        return;
                    seenParticipants.add(identityKey);
                    participants.push({
                        id: value?.id ? String(value.id) : null,
                        kind: String(value?.kind ?? 'npc'),
                        tokenEligible: value?.tokenEligible !== false && Boolean(value?.id),
                        name,
                        meta: String(value?.meta ?? '').trim(),
                        status: String(value?.status ?? '').trim(),
                        species: String(value?.species ?? '').trim(),
                        sex: String(value?.sex ?? '').trim(),
                        gender: String(value?.gender ?? '').trim(),
                        origin: String(value?.origin ?? '').trim(),
                        career: String(value?.career ?? '').trim(),
                        specialization: String(value?.specialization ?? '').trim(),
                        occupation: String(value?.occupation ?? '').trim(),
                        ageYears: Number.isFinite(Number(value?.ageYears)) ? Math.trunc(Number(value.ageYears)) : null,
                        appearance: String(value?.appearance ?? '').trim(),
                        visualFacts: Array.isArray(value?.visualFacts) ? value.visualFacts.map(String).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 8) : [],
                        visualTags: Array.isArray(value?.visualTags) ? value.visualTags.map(String).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 12) : [],
                    });
                };
                for (const npc of Object.values(world.npcs ?? {})) {
                    if (!npc?.knownToPlayer)
                        continue;
                    if (sceneVisibleNpcIds?.size) {
                        if (!sceneVisibleNpcIds.has(String(npc.id)))
                            continue;
                    }
                    else {
                        if (!sceneNarrativeText)
                            continue;
                        const needle = String(npc.name ?? '').trim().toLocaleLowerCase('pt-BR');
                        if (!needle || !sceneNarrativeText.includes(needle))
                            continue;
                    }
                    if (sceneLocationId && npc.locationId && npc.locationId !== sceneLocationId)
                        continue;
                    pushParticipant({
                        id: npc.id,
                        kind: 'npc',
                        name: npc.name,
                        meta: npc.relation || 'Conhecido',
                        status: npc.status || '',
                        species: npc.species || '', sex: npc.sex || '', gender: npc.gender || '', origin: npc.origin || '', career: npc.career || '', specialization: npc.specialization || '', occupation: npc.occupation || '', ageYears: npc.ageYears ?? null, appearance: npc.appearance || '',
                        visualFacts: (npc.facts ?? []).filter(f => f?.knownToPlayer).map(f => f.text),
                        visualTags: npc.tags ?? [],
                    });
                }
                if (state.combat?.active) {
                    for (const adversary of state.combat.adversaries ?? []) {
                        pushParticipant({
                            id: adversary.id ? `combat:${adversary.id}` : null,
                            kind: 'adversary',
                            name: adversary.name || adversary.id,
                            meta: 'Em confronto',
                            status: adversary.status || '',
                            visualFacts: Array.isArray(adversary.facts) ? adversary.facts.map(f => typeof f === 'string' ? f : f?.text).filter(Boolean) : [],
                            visualTags: Array.isArray(adversary.tags) ? adversary.tags : [],
                        });
                    }
                }
                if (state.vehicles?.combat?.active) {
                    const targetId = state.vehicles.combat.targetVehicleId;
                    const target = targetId ? state.vehicles.vehicles?.[targetId] ?? null : null;
                    if (target)
                        pushParticipant({ id: target.id ? `vehicle:${target.id}` : null, kind: 'vehicle', tokenEligible: false, name: target.name, meta: 'Veículo / nave alvo', status: 'Em confronto' });
                }
                const activeVehicleId = state.vehicles?.activeVehicleId ?? null;
                const activeVehicle = activeVehicleId ? state.vehicles?.vehicles?.[activeVehicleId] ?? null : null;
                const defense = activeVehicle?.defense ?? null;
                const vehicle = activeVehicle ? {
                    name: String(activeVehicle.name ?? ''),
                    hull: `${Number(activeVehicle.hullDamage ?? 0)}/${Number(activeVehicle.hullThreshold ?? 0)}`,
                    strain: `${Number(activeVehicle.systemStrain ?? 0)}/${Number(activeVehicle.systemStrainThreshold ?? 0)}`,
                    speed: `${Number(activeVehicle.speed ?? 0)}/${Number(activeVehicle.speedMax ?? 0)}`,
                    defense: defense ? `P${Number(defense.proa ?? 0)} · B${Number(defense.babor ?? 0)} · E${Number(defense.estribor ?? 0)} · R${Number(defense.popa ?? 0)}` : '—',
                } : null;
                let situation = '';
                const pendingQuestion = String(state.master?.pendingQuestion ?? '').trim();
                const pendingCheck = state.master?.suggestedCheck ?? null;
                if (pendingQuestion) {
                    situation = pendingQuestion;
                }
                else if (pendingCheck?.reason) {
                    situation = String(pendingCheck.reason).trim();
                }
                else if (state.vehicles?.combat?.active) {
                    situation = 'A nave está sob pressão. Escolha o próximo movimento.';
                }
                else if (state.combat?.active) {
                    situation = 'O confronto está aberto. Escolha sua próxima ação.';
                }
                else if (String(state.scene?.narration ?? '').trim()) {
                    situation = String(state.scene.narration).trim();
                }
                else if (state.session?.status === 'ativa') {
                    situation = 'Escolha uma das ações abaixo ou descreva outra ação ao Mestre.';
                }
                else {
                    situation = 'Inicie a sessão para receber a próxima decisão do Mestre.';
                }
                const sceneVisual = sceneLibrary_mjs_1.resolveSceneVisualForState(state);
                return ok({
                    scene: { title: String(state.scene?.title ?? ''), location, imageAssetId: sceneVisual.asset?.assetId ?? null, imageSource: sceneVisual.source, image: sceneVisual.descriptor, imageFallback: sceneVisual.asset ? null : 'gemini' },
                    situation: String(situation).slice(0, 900),
                    participants,
                    suggestedActions: Array.isArray(state.master?.suggestedActions) ? state.master.suggestedActions.map(String).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 6) : [],
                    suggestedCheck: state.master?.suggestedCheck ? clone(state.master.suggestedCheck) : null,
                    vehicle,
                    session: state.session ? { status: state.session.status, phase: state.session.phase, number: state.session.number } : null,
                    lastCheck: state.lastCheck ? clone(state.lastCheck) : null,
                });
            }
            catch (error) {
                return fail('PLAYER_VIEW_FAILED', messageOf(error));
            }
        }

        exportCharacterJson() {
            const controllerResult = this._controllerForExistingCampaign();
            if (!controllerResult.ok)
                return controllerResult;
            try {
                const game = controllerResult.data;
                const json = game.exportCharacter();
                const name = String(game.state.player?.character?.name ?? 'personagem').trim() || 'personagem';
                const safeName = name.normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+/g, '_').replace(/^_+|_+$/g, '') || 'personagem';
                return ok({ fileName: `${safeName}.json`, json });
            }
            catch (error) {
                return fail('CHARACTER_EXPORT_FAILED', messageOf(error));
            }
        }
        generateRandomCharacter(options = {}, { createSnapshot = true } = {}) {

                return controllerResult;

                return ok({ character: clone(created), snapshotId, state: clone(game.state) });
            }
            catch (error) {
                return fail('RANDOM_CHARACTER_FAILED', messageOf(error));
            }
        }

        creationCatalog(origin = null) {
            try {
                const state = this.repository.load();
                const mode = String(state?.campaignMode ?? 'EOTE').toUpperCase();
                const requestedOrigin = String(origin ?? (mode === 'AOR' ? 'AOR' : 'EOTE')).toUpperCase();
                const useAor = mode === 'AOR' || (mode === 'MIXED' && requestedOrigin === 'AOR');
                const speciesSource = useAor ? characterCreation_mjs_1.AOR_SPECIES : eoteCharacterCreation_mjs_1.EOTE_SPECIES;
                const careerSource = useAor ? characterCreation_mjs_1.AOR_CAREERS : eoteCharacterCreation_mjs_1.EOTE_CAREERS;
                const species = Object.entries(speciesSource).map(([key, value]) => ({
                    key,
                    label: value.label,
                    characteristics: clone(value.characteristics),
                    woundBase: value.woundBase,
                    strainBase: value.strainBase,
                    xp: value.xp,
                    careerFreeCount: value.careerFreeCount ?? 4,
                    specializationFreeCount: value.specFreeCount ?? 2,
                    freeSkill: value.freeSkill ? clone(value.freeSkill) : null,
                    freeTalents: clone(value.freeTalents ?? []),
                    speciesChoice: value.speciesChoice ? clone(value.speciesChoice) : null,
                    abilities: clone(value.abilities ?? []),
                }));
                const careers = Object.entries(careerSource).map(([key, value]) => ({
                    key,
                    label: value.label,
                    skills: clone(value.skills),
                    specializations: Object.entries(value.specializations ?? {}).map(([specializationKey, specialization]) => ({ key: specializationKey, label: specialization.label, skills: clone(specialization.skills) })),
                }));
                return ok({
                    profile: 'EOTE_CORE',
                    activeProfile: useAor ? 'AOR_CORE' : 'EOTE_CORE',
                    campaignMode: mode,
                    creationOrigin: useAor ? 'AOR' : 'EOTE',
                    species,
                    careers,
                    obligationTypes: clone(useAor ? characterCreation_mjs_1.DUTY_TYPES_PT_BR : eoteCharacterCreation_mjs_1.OBLIGATION_TYPES_PT_BR),
                    characteristicLabels: clone(labelsPtBr_mjs_1.CHARACTERISTIC_LABELS_PT_BR),
                    skillLabels: clone(labelsPtBr_mjs_1.SKILL_LABELS_PT_BR),
                });
            }
            catch (error) {
                return fail('CREATION_CATALOG_FAILED', messageOf(error));
            }
        }
        creationPreview(options = {}) {
            try {
                const state = this.repository.load();
                const mode = String(state?.campaignMode ?? 'EOTE').toUpperCase();
                const requestedOrigin = String(options?.creationOrigin ?? (mode === 'AOR' ? 'AOR' : 'EOTE')).toUpperCase();
                const useAor = mode === 'AOR' || (mode === 'MIXED' && requestedOrigin === 'AOR');
                if (!useAor) {
                    const preview = eoteCharacterCreation_mjs_1.eoteCreationPreview(options);
                    if (!preview)
                        return fail('INVALID_INPUT', 'Selecione uma espécie válida para calcular o orçamento de criação.');
                    return ok(clone(preview));
                }
                const mapped = { ...clone(options), dutyType: options.obligationType, dutyReductions: clone(options.obligationBenefits ?? {}) };
                const preview = characterCreation_mjs_1.creationPreview(mapped);
                if (!preview)
                    return fail('INVALID_INPUT', 'Selecione uma espécie válida para calcular o orçamento de criação.');
                return ok({
                    xpBudget: preview.xpBudget, characteristicCost: preview.characteristicCost, xpRemaining: preview.xpRemaining, credits: preview.credits,
                    obligation: preview.duty, startingObligation: preview.duty + preview.dutySpent, additionalObligation: -preview.dutySpent,
                    obligationOfficial: preview.dutyOfficial, obligationNote: preview.dutyNote ?? null, speciesXpBonus: 0,
                    activeProfile: 'AOR_CORE', duty: preview.duty, dutySpent: preview.dutySpent
                });
            }
            catch (error) {
                return fail('CREATION_PREVIEW_FAILED', messageOf(error));
            }
        }
        createCustomCharacter(options = {}, { createSnapshot = true } = {}) {
            const controllerResult = this._controllerForExistingCampaign();
            if (!controllerResult.ok)
                return controllerResult;
            const game = controllerResult.data;
            let snapshotId = null;
            try {
                const mode = String(game.state.campaignMode ?? 'EOTE').toUpperCase();
                const requestedOrigin = String(options?.creationOrigin ?? (mode === 'AOR' ? 'AOR' : 'EOTE')).toUpperCase();
                const useAor = mode === 'AOR' || (mode === 'MIXED' && requestedOrigin === 'AOR');
                let mapped = null;
                if (useAor) {
                    mapped = { ...clone(options), dutyType: options.obligationType, dutyReductions: clone(options.obligationBenefits ?? {}) };
                    characterCreation_mjs_1.createAorCoreCharacter(mapped);
                }
                else {
                    eoteCharacterCreation_mjs_1.createEoteCoreCharacter(options);
                }
                if (createSnapshot && game.state.player?.character)
                    snapshotId = this.snapshots.create(game.state, 'Antes de criar ficha manual').id;
                const created = useAor ? game.createAorCharacter(mapped) : game.createCustomCharacter(options);
                return ok({ character: clone(created), snapshotId, state: clone(game.state) });
            }
            catch (error) {
                if (snapshotId) {
                    try {
                        this.snapshots.remove(snapshotId);
                    }
                    catch { }
                }
                return fail('CUSTOM_CHARACTER_FAILED', messageOf(error));
            }
        }
        ownedSpecializations() {
            const controllerResult = this._controllerForExistingCampaign();
            if (!controllerResult.ok)
                return controllerResult;
            try {
                return ok(clone(controllerResult.data.ownedSpecializations()));

        async submitPlayerIntent(text, { fetchImpl = globalThis.fetch, timeoutMs = 60000, signal = null } = {}) {
            const intentText = String(text ?? '').trim();
            if (!intentText)
                return fail('INVALID_INPUT', 'Digite uma ação.');
            const controllerResult = this._controllerForExistingCampaign();
            if (!controllerResult.ok)
                return controllerResult;
            const game = controllerResult.data;
            try {
                // Provider HTTP explícito continua sendo autoridade quando configurado.
                if (game.state.settings?.masterProvider === 'http') {
                    const result = await game.requestMasterTurn({
                        intentText,
                        endpoint: game.state.settings.masterEndpoint,
                        fetchImpl,
                        timeoutMs,
                        signal,
                    });
                    return ok({ mode: 'http', result: clone(result), state: clone(game.state) });
                }
                // No Android final, Gemini é o narrador padrão quando a chave está configurada.
                // A mutação continua passando exclusivamente por requestMasterTurn/validateMasterProposal.
                const native = nativeGeminiStatus(globalThis);
                if (native.available && native.configured) {
                    if (game.state.player?.character && game.state.session?.status !== 'ativa')
                        game.startSession();
                    const nativeFetch = async (_url, init = {}) => {
                        let providerPayload;
                        try {
                            providerPayload = JSON.parse(String(init.body ?? '{}'));
                        }
                        catch {
                            throw new Error('Contexto serializado do Motor Barbara inválido.');
                        }
                        const remote = await requestNativeGeminiMaster(providerPayload, { timeoutMs, target: globalThis });
                        const allowedRuleIds = new Set((providerPayload?.context?.rules ?? []).map(rule => String(rule?.id ?? '')).filter(Boolean));
                        const proposal = clone(remote.proposal ?? {});
                        if (Array.isArray(proposal.sourceRuleIds)) {
                            proposal.sourceRuleIds = proposal.sourceRuleIds.map(String).filter(id => allowedRuleIds.has(id));
                        }
                        return { ok: true, status: 200, json: async () => ({ proposal, meta: { provider: 'gemini-native', model: remote.model ?? native.model ?? null } }) };
                    };
                    const result = await game.requestMasterTurn({
                        intentText,
                        endpoint: 'https://braseiro.native/master',
                        fetchImpl: nativeFetch,
                        timeoutMs,
                        signal,
                    });
                    return ok({ mode: 'gemini-native', result: clone(result), state: clone(game.state) });
                }
                // Fallback local deliberadamente não inventa prosa: registra a intenção, consulta o
                // contexto/regras canônicas e mantém a campanha utilizável mesmo sem rede/chave.
                const result = game.submitIntent(intentText);
                return ok({
                    mode: 'local',
                    result: clone(result),
                    state: clone(game.state),
                    masterNotice: native.available && !native.configured
                        ? 'Configure a chave Gemini em AJUSTES → Gemini / provedor para habilitar a narração automática.'
                        : 'Narrador remoto indisponível; o Motor Barbara local preservou estado e contexto de regras.',
                });
            }
            catch (error) {
                return fail('ENGINE_REJECTED', messageOf(error));
            }
        }
    }
    exports.BraseiroUiBridge = BraseiroUiBridge;
    function createBraseiroUiBridge(options = {}) {
        return new BraseiroUiBridge(options);
    }
    function installBraseiroUiBridge(target = globalThis, options = {}) {
        if (!target || (typeof target !== 'object' && typeof target !== 'function'))
            throw new Error('Alvo global inválido para a ponte de UI.');
        if (target.BraseiroGameBridge)
            return target.BraseiroGameBridge;
        const bridge = createBraseiroUiBridge(options);
        Object.defineProperty(target, 'BraseiroGameBridge', {
            value: bridge,
            configurable: false,
            enumerable: false,
            writable: false,
        });
        return bridge;
    }

    const SKILL_KEY = Object.freeze({ 'Manha': 'callejeo', 'Percepção': 'percepcion', 'Negociação': 'negociacion', 'Conhecimento (Submundo)': 'bajos_fondos', 'Charme': 'carisma', 'Coerção': 'coaccion', 'Mecânica': 'mecanica', 'Liderança': 'liderazgo', 'Coordenação': 'coordinacion', 'Atletismo': 'atletismo', 'Pilotagem (Planetária)': 'pilotar_vehiculo_planetario', 'Pilotagem (Espacial)': 'pilotar_vehiculo_espacial', 'Astrogação': 'astronavegacion' });
    function poolForDifficulty(text = 'Média') { const t = String(text).toLowerCase(); let difficulty = t.includes('formid') ? 5 : t.includes('desafi') ? 4 : t.includes('difí') || t.includes('dific') ? 3 : t.includes('méd') || t.includes('med') ? 2 : 1; const challenge = (t.match(/desafio|desafio/g) || []).length; const setback = (t.match(/revés|reves/g) || []).length; return { difficulty, challenge, setback }; }
    function baseSystems() { return { imperialExposure: 0, chase: { lead: 0, rounds: 0, status: 'idle' }, encounters: { activeId: null, history: [] } }; }
    function ensureSystems(p) { p.systems = p.systems && typeof p.systems === 'object' ? p.systems : baseSystems(); p.systems.imperialExposure = clamp(p.systems.imperialExposure, 0, 6); p.systems.chase = { ...baseSystems().chase, ...(p.systems.chase || {}) }; p.systems.encounters = { ...baseSystems().encounters, ...(p.systems.encounters || {}) }; p.flags = p.flags && typeof p.flags === 'object' ? p.flags : {}; p.checkHistory = Array.isArray(p.checkHistory) ? p.checkHistory : []; p.visitedNodeIds = Array.isArray(p.visitedNodeIds) ? p.visitedNodeIds : []; }
    function baseProgress({ rewardsApplied = false } = {}) { return { id: ID, title: exports.BEYOND_THE_RIM.title, status: 'active', currentNodeId: exports.BEYOND_THE_RIM.startNodeId, visitedNodeIds: [], flags: {}, systems: baseSystems(), checkHistory: [], consequencesApplied: false, startedAt: now(), updatedAt: now(), completedAt: null, rewardsApplied: Boolean(rewardsApplied), source: SOURCE, implementation: { episodesImplemented: [1], episodesTotal: 3 } }; }
    function conditionOk(choice, p) { const c = choice?.condition; if (!c)
        return true; if (c.startsWith('unvisited:'))
        return !p.visitedNodeIds.includes(c.slice(10)); if (c.startsWith('flag:'))
        return Boolean(p.flags?.[c.slice(5)]); if (c === 'prep-ready')
        return p.visitedNodeIds.includes('hangar-investigation') || p.visitedNodeIds.includes('ship-security'); return true; }
    function playerNode(node, p) { if (!node)
        return null; return { id: p.currentNodeId, episode: node.episode, title: node.title, locationId: node.locationId, summary: node.summary, narration: node.narration, visibleNpcIds: [...(node.visibleNpcIds || [])], checks: clone(node.checks || []), choices: (node.choices || []).filter(c => conditionOk(c, p)).map(c => ({ id: c.id, label: c.label })) }; }
    function revealCurrentNodeNpcs(world, node) { for (const id of node?.visibleNpcIds || []) {
        const n = world?.npcs?.[id];
        if (n)
            n.knownToPlayer = true;
    } if ((node?.visibleNpcIds || []).includes(NPC.yav) && world?.factions?.[FACTION.yiyar])
        world.factions[FACTION.yiyar].knownToPlayer = true; }
    function safePortraitAsset(value) { const v = String(value || '').trim(); return /^assets\/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+\.(?:png|webp|jpg|jpeg)$/i.test(v) ? v : ''; }
    function playerNpcCards(world, node) { return (node?.visibleNpcIds || []).map(id => world?.npcs?.[id]).filter(n => n?.knownToPlayer).map(n => ({ id: n.id, name: n.name, species: n.species || '', occupation: n.occupation || n.career || '', relation: n.relation || 'neutral', status: n.status || 'active', appearance: n.appearance || '', portraitAsset: safePortraitAsset(n.portraitAsset) })); }
    function playerKnownClues(p) { const v = new Set(p?.visitedNodeIds || []), f = p?.flags || {}, out = []; const add = (id, title, summary, sourceNodeId) => { if (!out.some(x => x.id === id))
        out.push({ id, title, summary, sourceNodeId }); }; if (v.has('isotech-briefing'))

        add('rumor', 'PISTA · SA NALAOR', 'Os rumores confirmam que outras pessoas voltaram a procurar a antiga nave separatista.', 'hangar-investigation'); if (f.imperialTrackerDetected)
        add('tracker', 'RISCO · VIGILÂNCIA', 'O grupo detectou sinais de vigilância técnica junto à própria nave.', 'ship-security'); if (f.imperialTrackerRemoved)
        add('tracker-removed', 'SEGURANÇA · RASTREADOR', 'O dispositivo suspeito foi removido antes da partida.', 'ship-security'); if (f.droidRecovered)
        add('it3po', 'ATIVO · IT-3PO', 'IT-3PO está com o grupo e pode seguir na expedição.', 'yiyar-chase'); if (f.yiyarHasDroid || f.droidLost)
        add('yiyar-ahead', 'RIVAIS · YIYAR', 'Os Yiyar escaparam com IT-3PO e ganharam vantagem de tempo.', 'yiyar-chase'); return out; }
    function playerCheckFeedback(p) { return (p?.checkHistory || []).filter(e => p.visitedNodeIds?.includes(e.nodeId)).slice(-6).map(e => ({ id: e.checkId, nodeId: e.nodeId, success: Boolean(e.success), summary: e.summary || (e.success ? 'O teste abriu uma oportunidade útil nesta cena.' : 'O teste trouxe uma complicação nesta cena.'), advantage: Number(e.netAdvantage) || 0, triumph: Number(e.triumph) || 0, despair: Number(e.despair) || 0 })); }

        try {
            (0, livingWorldDepth_mjs_1.ensureLivingWorldDepth)(next);

    function startBeyondTheRim(world) { const next = seedBeyondTheRimWorld(world); next.publishedAdventure = baseProgress({ rewardsApplied: Boolean(next.publishedAdventureRewards?.[ID]) }); const p = next.publishedAdventure; p.visitedNodeIds = [p.currentNodeId]; p.updatedAt = now(); next.publishedAdventure = p; return { world: next, progress: clone(p), node: playerNode(exports.BEYOND_THE_RIM.nodes[p.currentNodeId], p) }; }
    function currentBeyondTheRimChecks(world) { const p = world?.publishedAdventure; if (!p || p.id !== ID || p.status !== 'active')
        return []; const node = exports.BEYOND_THE_RIM.nodes[p.currentNodeId]; return (node?.checks || []).map((c, index) => ({ id: `${p.currentNodeId}:check:${index}`, index, skill: c.skill, skillKey: SKILL_KEY[c.skill] || null, difficultyText: c.difficulty, purpose: c.purpose, pool: poolForDifficulty(c.difficulty) })); }
    function adjudicationSummary(p, nodeId, spec, result) { if (nodeId === 'isotech-briefing' && spec.skill === 'Negociação')
        return result.success ? 'Reom aceita condições um pouco melhores sem quebrar o acordo.' : 'Reom mantém os termos e deixa claro que o tempo é curto.'; if (nodeId === 'hangar-investigation')
        return result.success ? 'A investigação separou um rumor útil do ruído da estação.' : 'As perguntas chamaram mais atenção do que trouxeram certeza.'; if (nodeId === 'ship-security')
        return p.flags.imperialTrackerRemoved ? 'A inspeção localizou e removeu o dispositivo suspeito.' : p.flags.imperialTrackerDetected ? 'A inspeção confirmou vigilância, mas o risco ainda não foi totalmente neutralizado.' : result.success ? 'A nave foi revisada sem encontrar ameaça imediata.' : 'A inspeção terminou sem certeza de que o casco está limpo.'; if (nodeId === 'yiyar-chase')
        return p.flags.droidRecovered ? 'A perseguição virou: IT-3PO está de volta com o grupo.' : p.flags.droidLost ? 'Os Yiyar abriram distância suficiente para escapar com IT-3PO.' : result.success ? 'O grupo ganhou terreno sobre os Yiyar.' : 'Os rivais ganharam espaço na fuga.'; if (nodeId === 'security-resolution')
        return p.flags.droidRecovered ? 'A Segurança da Roda reconheceu a tentativa de roubo e manteve IT-3PO com o grupo.' : p.flags.droidLost ? 'A confusão burocrática abriu uma janela para a fuga dos Yiyar.' : result.success ? 'A versão do grupo ganhou credibilidade diante da segurança.' : 'A situação ficou mais lenta e confusa.'; return result.success ? 'O teste abriu uma oportunidade útil nesta cena.' : 'O teste trouxe uma complicação nesta cena.'; }
    function adjudicateBeyondTheRimCheck(world, { checkIndex = 0, result = {} } = {}) {
        const next = seedBeyondTheRimWorld(world);
        const p = next.publishedAdventure;
        if (!p || p.id !== ID || p.status !== 'active')
            throw new Error('A aventura publicada não está ativa.');
        ensureSystems(p);
        const specs = currentBeyondTheRimChecks(next);
        const requested = Number(checkIndex);
        const spec = specs.find(x => x.index === requested) || specs[requested];
        if (!spec)
            throw new Error('Teste da aventura indisponível neste ponto.');
        const success = Boolean(result.success), netAdvantage = Number(result.netAdvantage) || 0, triumph = Math.max(0, Number(result.triumph) || 0), despair = Math.max(0, Number(result.despair) || 0);
        const nodeId = p.currentNodeId;
        if ((nodeId === 'wheel-arrival' || nodeId === 'hangar-investigation' || nodeId === 'ship-security') && (!success || netAdvantage < 0 || despair > 0))
            p.systems.imperialExposure = clamp(p.systems.imperialExposure + Math.max(1, Math.max(0, -netAdvantage) + despair), 0, 6);
        if (nodeId === 'isotech-briefing' && spec.skill === 'Negociação' && success)
            p.flags.termsImproved = true;
        if (nodeId === 'hangar-investigation' && success) {
            p.flags.rumorConfirmed = true;
            if (triumph > 0 || netAdvantage >= 2)
                p.flags.routeIntel = true;
        }
        if (nodeId === 'ship-security') {
            if (spec.skill === 'Percepção' && success)
                p.flags.imperialTrackerDetected = true;
            if (spec.skill === 'Mecânica' && success) {
                p.flags.imperialTrackerDetected = true;
                p.flags.imperialTrackerRemoved = true;
                p.flags.imperialTrackerAttached = false;
            }
            if (!success && (despair > 0 || netAdvantage <= -2)) {
                p.flags.imperialTrackerAttached = true;
                if (despair > 0)
                    p.flags.isbAttention = true;
            }
        }
        if (nodeId === 'yiyar-chase') {
            let delta = success ? 1 : -1;
            if (netAdvantage >= 2)
                delta += 1;
            if (netAdvantage <= -2)
                delta -= 1;
            if (triumph > 0)
                delta += 1;
            if (despair > 0)
                delta -= 1;
            p.systems.chase.lead = clamp(Number(p.systems.chase.lead) + delta, -3, 3);
            p.systems.chase.rounds = Math.max(0, Number(p.systems.chase.rounds) || 0) + 1;
            p.systems.chase.status = 'active';
            if (p.systems.chase.lead >= 2) {
                p.flags.droidRecovered = true;
                p.flags.droidLost = false;
                p.flags.yiyarHasDroid = false;
                p.systems.chase.status = 'won';
            }
            else if (p.systems.chase.lead <= -2) {
                p.flags.droidLost = true;
                p.flags.droidRecovered = false;
                p.flags.yiyarHasDroid = true;
                p.systems.chase.status = 'lost';
            }
        }
        if (nodeId === 'security-resolution') {
            if (success) {
                p.flags.droidRecovered = true;
                p.flags.droidLost = false;
                p.flags.yiyarHasDroid = false;
            }
            else if (despair > 0 || netAdvantage <= -2) {
                p.flags.droidLost = true;
                p.flags.droidRecovered = false;
                p.flags.yiyarHasDroid = true;
            }
        }
        const summary = adjudicationSummary(p, nodeId, spec, { success, netAdvantage, triumph, despair });
        const entry = { at: now(), nodeId, checkId: spec.id, skillKey: spec.skillKey, success, netSuccess: Number(result.netSuccess) || 0, netAdvantage, triumph, despair, summary, systems: { imperialExposure: p.systems.imperialExposure, chase: clone(p.systems.chase) } };
        p.checkHistory = [...(p.checkHistory || []), entry].slice(-50);
        p.updatedAt = now();
        next.publishedAdventure = p;
        return { world: next, progress: clone(p), adjudication: clone(entry) };
    }
    function advanceBeyondTheRim(world, choiceId) { const next = seedBeyondTheRimWorld(world); const p = next.publishedAdventure; if (!p || p.id !== ID || p.status !== 'active')
        throw new Error('A aventura publicada não está ativa.'); ensureSystems(p); const node = exports.BEYOND_THE_RIM.nodes[p.currentNodeId]; if (!node)
        throw new Error('Nó atual da aventura não existe.'); const choice = (node.choices || []).find(c => c.id === String(choiceId)); if (!choice || !conditionOk(choice, p))
        throw new Error('Escolha indisponível neste ponto da aventura.'); p.flags = { ...(p.flags || {}), ...(choice.effects || {}) }; const target = exports.BEYOND_THE_RIM.nodes[choice.to]; if (!target)
        throw new Error('Destino da aventura não existe.'); p.currentNodeId = choice.to; if (!p.visitedNodeIds.includes(choice.to))
        p.visitedNodeIds.push(choice.to); if (choice.to === 'droid-delivery' && p.flags.imperialTrackerAttached)
        p.flags.departureTracked = true; if (choice.to === 'episode1-boundary') {
        p.flags.episode1Complete = true;
        p.flags.departureTracked = Boolean(p.flags.imperialTrackerAttached && !p.flags.imperialTrackerRemoved);
        next.publishedAdventureConsequences = { ...(next.publishedAdventureConsequences || {}), [ID]: { episode: 1, recordedAt: now(), partyAhead: Boolean(p.flags.partyAhead), yiyarHasDroid: Boolean(p.flags.yiyarHasDroid), departureTracked: Boolean(p.flags.departureTracked), termsImproved: Boolean(p.flags.termsImproved), routeIntel: Boolean(p.flags.routeIntel) } };
    } revealCurrentNodeNpcs(next, target); p.updatedAt = now(); next.publishedAdventure = p; return { world: next, progress: clone(p), node: playerNode(target, p), choiceEffects: clone(choice.effects || {}), completed: false }; }
    function currentBeyondTheRimSystems(world) { const p = world?.publishedAdventure; if (!p || p.id !== ID)
        return []; ensureSystems(p); return [{ id: 'imperial-exposure', label: 'Exposição imperial', value: Number(p.systems.imperialExposure) || 0, min: 0, max: 6, status: p.systems.imperialExposure >= 4 ?     function conditionOk(choice, progress) { const c = choice.condition; if (!c)
        return true; if (c.startsWith('unvisited:'))
        return !progress.visitedNodeIds.includes(c.slice(10)); if (c.startsWith('investigated:')) {
        const n = Number(c.slice(13)) || 0;
        return progress.investigationLocations.length >= n;
    } if (c.startsWith('flag:'))
        return Boolean(progress.flags?.[c.slice(5)]); if (c.startsWith('check-success:')) {
        const nodeId = c.slice(14);
        if (nodeId === 'kaato-parley' && progress.flags?.parleyBroken)
            return false;
        return (progress.checkHistory || []).some(x => x.nodeId === nodeId && x.success === true);
    } if (c.startsWith('encounter-resolved:')) {
        const id = c.slice(19);
        return (progress.systems?.encounters?.history || []).some(x => x.encounterId === id && x.outcome);
    } if (c === 'kaato-outcome:neutralized')
        return Boolean(progress.flags?.kaatoNeutralized) && (progress.systems?.encounters?.history || []).some(x => x.encounterId === 'kaato-showdown' && x.outcome); if (c === 'kaato-outcome:not-neutralized')
        return !progress.flags?.kaatoNeutralized && (progress.systems?.encounters?.history || []).some(x => x.encounterId === 'kaato-showdown' && x.outcome); return true; }
    function effectiveChecks(node, progress) { const checks = clone(node?.checks || []); if (progress?.currentNodeId === 'kaato-parley' && progress.flags?.parleyBroken)
        return []; if (progress?.currentNodeId !== 'novacore-plant')
        return checks; const route = progress.flags?.factoryRoute; if (route === 'offices')
        return checks.filter(c => c.skill === 'Computadores' || c.skill === 'Percepção'); if (route === 'refinery')
        return checks.filter(c => c.skill === 'Percepção' || c.skill === 'Frieza'); return checks; }
    function playerNode(node, progress) { if (!node)
        return null; let title = node.title, summary = node.summary, narration = node.narration, checks = effectiveChecks(node, progress); if (progress.currentNodeId === 'novacore-plant' && progress.flags?.factoryRoute === 'offices') {
        title = 'NovaCORE - escritórios e segurança';
        summary = 'A rota pelos escritórios permite atacar sensores, portas e registros antes de alcançar o setor abandonado.';
        narration = 'Terminais corporativos e corredores de manutenção formam uma faixa de segurança entre a plataforma e o anexo antigo. Droides passam em ciclos previsíveis; uma invasão limpa dos sistemas pode abrir o caminho sem transformar a planta inteira em uma zona de alerta.';
    }
    else if (progress.currentNodeId === 'novacore-plant' && progress.flags?.factoryRoute === 'refinery') {
        title = 'NovaCORE - refinaria';
        summary = 'A rota da refinaria evita os escritórios, mas troca vigilância por passarelas instáveis, vapor e equipamentos de kelerium.';
        narration = 'O grupo avança por passarelas quentes sobre tanques e linhas de processamento. Vapor corta a visão e cada desvio precisa ser medido contra o risco de acionar maquinaria antiga ou denunciar a posição para Kaa’to.';
    } return { id: progress.currentNodeId, episode: node.episode, title, locationId: node.locationId, summary, narration, visibleNpcIds: [...(node.visibleNpcIds || [])], checks, choices: (node.choices || []).filter(c => conditionOk(c, progress)).map(c => ({ id: c.id, label: c.label })) }; }
    function revealCurrentNodeNpcs(world, node) { for (const id of node?.visibleNpcIds || []) {
        const n = world?.npcs?.[id];
        if (n)
            n.knownToPlayer = true;
    } }
    function safePortraitAsset(value) { const v = String(value || '').trim(); return /^assets\/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+\.(?:png|webp|jpg|jpeg)$/i.test(v) ? v : ''; }
    function playerNpcCards(world, node) { return (node?.visibleNpcIds || []).map(id => world?.npcs?.[id]).filter(n => n?.knownToPlayer).map(n => ({ id: n.id, name: n.name, species: n.species || '', occupation: n.occupation || n.career || '', relation: n.relation || 'neutral', status: n.status || 'active', appearance: n.appearance || '', portraitAsset: safePortraitAsset(n.portraitAsset) })); }
    function playerCheckFeedback(progress) { return (progress?.checkHistory || []).filter(e => progress.visitedNodeIds?.includes(e.nodeId)).slice(-6).map(e => { let summary = e.success ? 'O teste abriu uma oportunidade útil nesta cena.' : 'O teste trouxe uma complicação nesta cena.'; const m = e.mechanics || {}; if (m.chase)
        summary = m.chase.lead >= 2 ? 'A perseguição virou a favor do grupo.' : m.chase.lead <= -2 ? 'O rastro ficou comprometido e a pressão aumentou.' : e.success ? 'O grupo ganhou terreno na perseguição.' : 'A perseguição apertou e o grupo perdeu terreno.';
    else if (m.sabacc)
        summary = m.creditDelta > 0 ? 'A rodada rendeu créditos e cobertura à mesa.' : m.creditDelta < 0 ? 'A rodada custou créditos, mas a investigação continua.' : 'A mesa permaneceu equilibrada.';
    else if (m.zelcomm)
        summary = m.zelcomm.lockdown ? 'A segurança da Zelcomm entrou em alerta reforçado.' : e.success ? 'A infiltração reduziu a pressão da segurança local.' : 'A segurança da Zelcomm ficou mais atenta.';
    else if (m.parley)
        summary = m.parley.broken ? 'A negociação se rompeu; Kaa’to não aceita prolongar a conversa.' : e.success ? 'A pressão sobre Kaa’to abriu espaço real para uma rendição.' : 'Kaa’to resistiu à pressão e a conversa ficou mais tensa.';
    else if (m.novacore)
        summary = m.novacore.critical ? 'Os riscos industriais da NovaCORE chegaram a um nível crítico.' : e.success ? 'O grupo controlou parte dos riscos da instalação.' : 'Os riscos da instalação aumentaram.'; return { id: e.checkId, nodeId: e.nodeId, success: Boolean(e.success), summary, advantage: Number(e.netAdvantage) || 0, triumph: Number(e.triumph) || 0, despair: Number(e.despair) || 0 }; }); }
    function playerKnownClues(progress) {
        const visited = new Set(progress?.visitedNodeIds || []), flags = progress?.flags || {}, out = [];
        const add = (id, title, summary, sourceNodeId) => { if (!out.some(x => x.id === id))

        if (visited.has('investigation-hub'))
            add('target-kaato', 'ALVO IDENTIFICADO', 'Os dados decifrados confirmam que a investigação procura Kaa’to e que três rotas do submundo podem levar até ele.', 'chop-talk');

            add('umbra-trail', 'PISTA · UMBRA', 'O Umbra confirma uma ligação recente entre Kaa’to e negócios conduzidos por Speng no Sector 1459.', 'umbra-club');
        if (flags.spyderLead && visited.has('spyder'))
            add('spyder-debt', 'PISTA · SPYDER', 'As dívidas de Kaa’to no Spyder criaram atrito suficiente para que sua movimentação deixe rastros no submundo.', 'spyder');
        if (flags.blackSunAgainstKaato && visited.has('spyder'))
            add('black-sun-pressure', 'PISTA · BLACK SUN', 'Verannis recebeu informação que pode colocar a Black Sun contra Kaa’to.', 'spyder');
        if ((flags.sector943Known || flags.zelcommLead) && visited.has('zelcomm-tower'))
            add('sector-943', 'PISTA · ZELCOMM', 'Registros e manifestos da Zelcomm conectam a movimentação de Kaa’to ao Sector 943.', 'zelcomm-tower');
        if (visited.has('endgame-plan'))
            add('novacore-convergence', 'PISTA · THE WORKS', 'As pistas reunidas convergem para uma área abandonada da planta NovaCORE em Sector 943.', 'endgame-plan');
        if (visited.has('novacore-landing') && flags.endgameApproach === 'trap')
            add('endgame-preparation', 'PREPARAÇÃO · ARMADILHA', 'O grupo preparou uma armadilha para reduzir a mobilidade de Kaa’to quando o confronto começar.', 'endgame-plan');
        if (visited.has('novacore-landing') && flags.endgameApproach === 'counter-ambush')
            add('endgame-preparation', 'PREPARAÇÃO · CONTRAEMBOSCADA', 'O grupo provocou Kaa’to para transformar a aproximação dele em uma contraemboscada.', 'endgame-plan');
        if (visited.has('novacore-plant') && flags.factoryRoute === 'offices')
            add('novacore-route', 'ROTA · ESCRITÓRIOS', 'A infiltração segue por terminais, portas e ciclos de segurança da NovaCORE.', 'novacore-plant');
        if (visited.has('novacore-plant') && flags.factoryRoute === 'refinery')
            add('novacore-route', 'ROTA · REFINARIA', 'A infiltração segue pelas passarelas e equipamentos industriais, evitando a área corporativa.', 'novacore-plant');
        if (visited.has('kaato-hideout'))
            add('hideout-logistics', 'PISTA · ESCONDERIJO', 'Caixas e rotas no esconderijo confirmam a mesma cadeia logística observada na Zelcomm.', 'kaato-hideout');
        if (progress?.status === 'completed' && visited.has('epilogue')) {
            const outcome = flags.kaatoOutcome;
            if (outcome === 'captured')
                add('kaato-outcome', 'DESFECHO', 'Kaa’to foi capturado ou incapacitado ao fim da caçada.', 'epilogue');
            else if (outcome === 'dead')
                add('kaato-outcome', 'DESFECHO', 'Kaa’to morreu no confronto final.', 'epilogue');
            else if (outcome === 'uncertain')
                add('kaato-outcome', 'DESFECHO', 'O paradeiro de Kaa’to não foi confirmado após o confronto.', 'epilogue');
        }
        return out.slice(-8);

    function baseSystems() { return { chases: { 'hot-pursuit': { lead: 0, rounds: 0, status: 'active', last: null }, 'speng-pursuit': { lead: 0, rounds: 0, status: 'active', last: null } }, sabacc: { rounds: 0, creditsDelta: 0, status: 'idle', last: null }, zelcomm: { alert: 0, lockdown: false, last: null }, novacore: { hazard: 0, critical: false, last: null }, encounters: { activeId: null, history: [] } }; }
    function ensureSystems(progress) { progress.systems = progress.systems && typeof progress.systems === 'object' ? progress.systems : baseSystems(); const d = baseSystems(); progress.systems.chases = { ...d.chases, ...(progress.systems.chases || {}) }; for (const k of Object.keys(d.chases))
        progress.systems.chases[k] = { ...d.chases[k], ...(progress.systems.chases[k] || {}) }; for (const k of ['sabacc', 'zelcomm', 'novacore', 'encounters'])
        progress.systems[k] = { ...d[k], ...(progress.systems[k] || {}) }; progress.systems.encounters.history = Array.isArray(progress.systems.encounters.history) ? progress.systems.encounters.history : []; return progress.systems; }
    function baseProgress({ rewardsApplied = false } = {}) { return { id: ID, title: exports.UNDER_BLACK_SUN.title, status: 'active', currentNodeId: exports.UNDER_BLACK_SUN.startNodeId, visitedNodeIds: [], investigationLocations: [], flags: { alertClock: 0, momentum: 0 }, systems: baseSystems(), checkHistory: [], consequencesApplied: false, startedAt: now(), updatedAt: now(), completedAt: null, rewardsApplied: Boolean(rewardsApplied), source: SOURCE }; }
    const SKILL_KEY = Object.freeze({ 'Pilotagem (Planetária)': 'pilotar_vehiculo_planetario', 'Percepção': 'percepcion', 'Furtividade': 'sigilo', 'Computadores': 'computadoras', 'Negociação': 'negociacion', 'Enganação': 'engano', 'Sobrevivência': 'supervivencia', 'Charme': 'carisma', 'Manha': 'callejeo', 'Falcatrua': 'actividad_criminal', 'Frieza': 'frialdad', 'Coerção': 'coaccion', 'Atletismo/Coordenação': 'atletismo' });
    function poolForDifficulty(text = '') { const t = String(text); let difficulty = /Difícil/i.test(t) ? 3 : /Média/i.test(t) ? 2 : /Fácil/i.test(t) ? 1 : 2; const explicit = t.match(/(\d+)\s+Dificuldade/i); if (explicit)
        difficulty = Number(explicit[1]); const challenge = (t.match(/(\d+)\s+Desafio/i) || [])[1]; const setback = (t.match(/(\d+)\s+Revés/i) || [])[1]; return { difficulty, challenge: Number(challenge || 0), setback: Number(setback || 0) }; }
    function currentUnderBlackSunChecks(world) { const p = world?.publishedAdventure; if (!p || p.id !== ID || p.status !== 'active')
        return []; const node = exports.UNDER_BLACK_SUN.nodes[p.currentNodeId]; const source = node?.checks || []; return effectiveChecks(node, p).map(c => { const index = source.findIndex(x => x.skill === c.skill && x.purpose === c.purpose); return { id: `${p.currentNodeId}:check:${index}`, index, skill: c.skill, skillKey: SKILL_KEY[c.skill] || null, difficultyText: c.difficulty, purpose: c.purpose, pool: poolForDifficulty(c.difficulty) }; }); }
    function clamp(n, min, max) { return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, Number(n) || 0)); }
    function nodeMechanics(progress, spec, { success, netAdvantage, triumph, despair }) {
        const systems = ensureSystems(progress);
        const nodeId = progress.currentNodeId;
        const mechanics = {};
        if (nodeId === 'hot-pursuit' || nodeId === 'speng-pursuit') {
            const chase = systems.chases[nodeId] || { lead: 0, rounds: 0, status: 'active', last: null };
            let delta = success ? 1 : -1;
            if (netAdvantage >= 2)
                delta += 1;
            if (netAdvantage <= -2)
                delta -= 1;
            delta += Math.min(1, triumph) - Math.min(1, despair);
            chase.lead = clamp(Number(chase.lead) + delta, -3, 3);
            chase.rounds = Number(chase.rounds || 0) + 1;
            chase.status = chase.lead >= 2 ? (nodeId === 'hot-pursuit' ? 'vantagem' : 'rastro_firme') : chase.lead <= -2 ? (nodeId === 'hot-pursuit' ? 'comprometida' : 'rastro_perdido') : 'active';
            chase.last = { success, delta, netAdvantage, triumph, despair };
            systems.chases[nodeId] = chase;
            mechanics.chase = { ...clone(chase), nodeId };
            if (chase.lead <= -2)
                progress.flags.kaatoAlerted = true;
        }
        if ((nodeId === 'spyder' && /sabacc/i.test(String(spec.purpose || ''))) || (nodeId === 'spyder-sabacc' && spec.skillKey === 'engano')) {
            const sabacc = systems.sabacc;
            let credits = success ? 50 : -50;
            if (netAdvantage >= 2)
                credits += 25;
            if (netAdvantage <= -2)
                credits -= 25;
            credits += triumph * 100 - despair * 100;
            sabacc.rounds = Number(sabacc.rounds || 0) + 1;
            sabacc.creditsDelta = Number(sabacc.creditsDelta || 0) + credits;
            sabacc.status = sabacc.rounds >= 3 ? (sabacc.creditsDelta > 0 ? 'won' : sabacc.creditsDelta < 0 ? 'lost' : 'draw') : 'active';
            sabacc.last = { success, credits, netAdvantage, triumph, despair };
            if (sabacc.status === 'won')
                progress.flags.spyderSabaccWon = true;
            if (sabacc.status === 'lost')
                progress.flags.spyderSabaccLost = true;
            mechanics.sabacc = clone(sabacc);
            mechanics.creditDelta = credits;
        }
        if (nodeId === 'zelcomm-tower') {
            const sec = systems.zelcomm;
            let localDelta = success ? -1 : 1;
            if (netAdvantage <= -2)
                localDelta += 1;
            if (netAdvantage >= 2)
                localDelta -= 1;
            localDelta += despair * 2 - triumph;
            sec.alert = clamp(Number(sec.alert || 0) + localDelta, 0, 6);
            sec.lockdown = sec.alert >= 4;
            sec.last = { success, delta: localDelta, netAdvantage, triumph, despair };
            if (sec.lockdown)
                progress.flags.zelcommAlarmed = true;
            if (sec.alert >= 6)
                progress.flags.policeAttention = true;
            mechanics.zelcomm = clone(sec);
        }
        if (nodeId === 'kaato-parley') {
            const pressure = Math.max(0, -netAdvantage) + despair * 2;
            const broken = !success && (despair > 0 || netAdvantage <= -2);
            if (broken) {
                progress.flags.parleyBroken = true;
                progress.flags.kaatoAlerted = true;
            }
            mechanics.parley = { success, broken, pressure, despair, netAdvantage };
        }
        if (['novacore-landing', 'novacore-plant', 'kaato-hideout', 'showdown'].includes(nodeId)) {
            const hz = systems.novacore;
            let hazardDelta = success ? -1 : 1;
            if (netAdvantage <= -2)
                hazardDelta += 1;
            if (netAdvantage >= 2)
                hazardDelta -= 1;
            hazardDelta += despair * 2 - triumph;
            hz.hazard = clamp(Number(hz.hazard || 0) + hazardDelta, 0, 6);
            hz.critical = hz.hazard >= 4;
            hz.last = { success, delta: hazardDelta, netAdvantage, triumph, despair };
            if (hz.critical)
                progress.flags.novacoreHazardEscalated = true;
            mechanics.novacore = clone(hz);
            mechanics.playerStrainDelta = Math.max(0, (despair * 2) + (netAdvantage <= -2 ? 1 : 0));
        }
        return mechanics;
    }
    function adjudicateUnderBlackSunCheck(world, { checkIndex = 0, result = {} } = {}) { const next = seedUnderBlackSunWorld(world); const p = next.publishedAdventure; if (p.status !== 'active')
        throw new Error('A aventura publicada não está ativa.'); ensureSystems(p); const available = currentUnderBlackSunChecks(next); const requestedIndex = Number(checkIndex); const spec = available.find(x => x.index === requestedIndex) || available[requestedIndex]; if (!spec)
        throw new Error('Teste da aventura indisponível neste ponto.'); const netAdvantage = Number(result.netAdvantage) || 0, triumph = Math.max(0, Number(result.triumph) || 0), despair = Math.max(0, Number(result.despair) || 0); const success = Boolean(result.success); const alertDelta = Math.max(0, -netAdvantage) + despair * 2; const momentumDelta = Math.max(0, netAdvantage) + triumph * 2; p.flags = { ...(p.flags || {}), alertClock: Math.min(6, Math.max(0, Number(p.flags?.alertClock) || 0) + alertDelta), momentum: Math.min(6, Math.max(0, Number(p.flags?.momentum) || 0) + momentumDelta), lastCheck: { nodeId: p.currentNodeId, checkId: spec.id, success, netSuccess: Number(result.netSuccess) || 0, netAdvantage, triumph, despair } }; if (p.flags.alertClock >= 4)
        p.flags.kaatoAlerted = true; if (p.flags.alertClock >= 6)
        p.flags.policeAttention = true; const mechanics = nodeMechanics(p, spec, { success, netAdvantage, triumph, despair }); const entry = { at: now(), nodeId: p.currentNodeId, checkId: spec.id, skillKey: spec.skillKey, success, netSuccess: Number(result.netSuccess) || 0, netAdvantage, triumph, despair, alertDelta, momentumDelta, mechanics: clone(mechanics) }; p.checkHistory = [...(p.checkHistory || []), entry].slice(-40); p.updatedAt = now(); next.publishedAdventure = p; return { world: next, progress: clone(p), adjudication: { ...entry, ...mechanics, alertClock: p.flags.alertClock, momentum: p.flags.momentum, kaatoAlerted: Boolean(p.flags.kaatoAlerted), policeAttention: Boolean(p.flags.policeAttention) } }; }
    function seedUnderBlackSunWorld(world) {
