        }
        beginPresetEncounter({ rng = Math.random, playerInitiativeSkill = 'alerta', npcInitiativeSkill = 'alerta', playerQuickReactionStrain = 0 } = {}) {
            const adversaries = [
                adversaries_mjs_1.createAdversary('imperial_soldier', { count: 3, range: 'Médio' }),
                adversaries_mjs_1.createAdversary('imperial_officer', { range: 'Médio' })
            ];
            return this.beginEncounter({ adversaries, rng, playerInitiativeSkill, npcInitiativeSkill, playerQuickReactionStrain });
        }
        beginEncounter({ adversaries, rng = Math.random, playerInitiativeSkill = 'alerta', npcInitiativeSkill = 'alerta', playerQuickReactionStrain = 0 } = {}) {
            let character = this.state.player.character;
            assertCanAct(character);
            if (!Array.isArray(adversaries) || !adversaries.length)
                throw new Error('O encontro precisa de adversários.');
            playerInitiativeSkill = initiativeSkillKey(playerInitiativeSkill);
            npcInitiativeSkill = initiativeSkillKey(npcInitiativeSkill);
            let combat = combat_mjs_1.startCombat(this.state.combat);
            const quickReaction = initiative_mjs_1.preparePlayerInitiative(character, { quickReactionStrain: playerQuickReactionStrain });
            character = quickReaction.character;
            assertCanAct(character);
            const playerCharacteristic = character_mjs_1.SKILLS[playerInitiativeSkill];
            const playerPool = narrativeDice_mjs_1.buildPositivePool(character.characteristics[playerCharacteristic], character.skills[playerInitiativeSkill] ?? 0);
            const playerCheck = narrativeDice_mjs_1.rollPool({ ...playerPool, boost: quickReaction.boost }, rng);
            const entries = [initiative_mjs_1.initiativeEntry({ id: 'player', side: 'player', check: playerCheck, label: character.name })];
            for (const adversary of adversaries) {
                const pool = narrativeDice_mjs_1.buildPositivePool(adversaries_mjs_1.adversaryCharacteristicForSkill(adversary, npcInitiativeSkill), adversaries_mjs_1.adversarySkillRank(adversary, npcInitiativeSkill));
                const check = narrativeDice_mjs_1.rollPool(pool, rng);
                entries.push(initiative_mjs_1.initiativeEntry({ id: adversary.id, side: 'npc', check, label: adversary.name }));
            }
            combat = encounter_mjs_1.setupEncounter(combat, { entries, adversaries, playerActorId: 'player' });
            const progressed = this._processNpcTurnsUntilPlayer(combat, character, rng);
            combat = progressed.combat;
            character = progressed.character;
            this.commit('COMBAT_ACTION', { combat, character, check: playerCheck });
            if (this.state.session?.status === 'ativa')
                this.commit('SESSION_COMBAT_STARTED', { session: sessionFlow_mjs_1.noteSessionCombatStarted(this.state.session) });
            return { combat, character, playerCheck, entries, npcTurns: progressed.npcTurns, quickReaction: quickReaction.quickReaction };
        }
        _processNpcTurnsUntilPlayer(combat, character, rng = Math.random) {
            let nextCombat = clone(combat);
            let nextCharacter = clone(character);
            const npcTurns = [];
            let guard = 0;
            while (nextCombat.active && guard++ < 30) {
                if (encounter_mjs_1.encounterOver(nextCombat, health_mjs_1.getHealthStatus(nextCharacter).unconscious)) {
                    nextCombat.encounter = nextCombat.encounter ?? {};
                    nextCombat.encounter.waitingForPlayer = false;
                    nextCombat.encounter.outcome = health_mjs_1.getHealthStatus(nextCharacter).unconscious ? 'player_incapacitated' : 'adversaries_defeated';
                    break;
                }
                const slot = encounter_mjs_1.currentSlot(nextCombat);
                if (!slot)
                    break;
                if (slot.side === 'player') {
                    nextCombat = encounter_mjs_1.assignCurrentSlot(nextCombat, 'player');
                    break;
                }
                const available = encounter_mjs_1.availableActorsForCurrentSlot(nextCombat);
                if (!available.length) {
                    nextCombat = encounter_mjs_1.skipCurrentSlot(nextCombat, { summary: 'Nenhum adversário ativo disponível para esta posição.' });
                    continue;
                }
                const actorId = available[0];
                nextCombat = encounter_mjs_1.assignCurrentSlot(nextCombat, actorId);
                const resolved = this._resolveNpcTurn(nextCombat, nextCharacter, actorId, rng);
                nextCombat = resolved.combat;
                nextCharacter = resolved.character;
                npcTurns.push(resolved.summary);
                nextCombat = encounter_mjs_1.completeCurrentSlot(nextCombat, actorId, { summary: resolved.summary.text });
            }
            if (guard >= 30)
                throw new Error('Proteção de loop da iniciativa acionada.');
            return { combat: nextCombat, character: nextCharacter, npcTurns };
        }
        _resolveNpcTurn(combat, character, adversaryId, rng = Math.random) {
            const adversary = combat.adversaries.find(a => a.id === adversaryId);
            if (!adversary)
                throw new Error('Adversário não encontrado no encontro.');
            if (adversaries_mjs_1.adversaryHealthStatus(adversary).incapacitated) {
                return { combat, character, summary: { actorId: adversaryId, text: `${adversary.name} está incapacitado e não age.` } };
            }
            const weapon = chooseNpcWeapon(adversary);
            if (!weapon) {
                return { combat, character, summary: { actorId: adversaryId, text: `${adversary.name} não possui ataque utilizável nesta distância.` } };
            }
            const characteristic = adversaries_mjs_1.adversaryCharacteristicForSkill(adversary, weapon.skill);
            const skill = adversaries_mjs_1.adversarySkillRank(adversary, weapon.skill);
            const positive = narrativeDice_mjs_1.buildPositivePool(characteristic, skill);
            const difficulty = attackDifficulty_mjs_1.attackDifficultyForWeapon(weapon, adversary.range);
            const pendingBoost = Number(combat.pendingNpcBoost ?? 0);
            const check = narrativeDice_mjs_1.rollPool({
                ...positive,
                difficulty,
                challenge: 0,
                boost: pendingBoost,
                setback: defenseSetback(character, weapon)
            }, rng);
            let attack = weapons_mjs_1.resolveWeaponHit(weapon, check);
            attack = { ...attack, targetRange: adversary.range, difficulty, attackerId: adversary.id, attackerName: adversary.name };
            let nextCombat = clone(combat);
            let nextCharacter = clone(character);
            nextCombat.pendingNpcBoost = 0;
            let damageResult = null;
            let criticalResult = null;
            let targetText = 'falhou o ataque';
            if (attack.hit) {
                damageResult = health_mjs_1.applyDamage(nextCharacter, { damage: attack.damage, pierce: attack.pierce, damageType: attack.damageType, reason: `Ataque de ${adversary.name}`, criticalRng: rng });
                nextCharacter = damageResult.character;
                targetText = `acertou e causou ${damageResult.suffered} ${damageResult.damageType === 'strain' ? 'de Tensão' : 'Ferimento(s)'}`;
                if (damageResult.suffered > 0 && attack.criticalAvailable) {
                    criticalResult = critical_mjs_1.addStarterCritical(nextCharacter, `Crítico de ${adversary.name}`, { rng });
                    nextCharacter = criticalResult.character;
                    if (criticalResult.added)
                        targetText += ' + 1 Ferimento Crítico';
                }
            }
            let updatedAdversary = adversary;
            const threatCost = Math.max(0, -Number(check.netAdvantage || 0)) + Math.max(0, Number(check.despair || 0));
            if (threatCost > 0) {
                const consequence = adversaries_mjs_1.sufferAdversaryStrain(updatedAdversary, threatCost);
                updatedAdversary = consequence.adversary;
                targetText += consequence.convertedToWounds ? `; ${adversary.name} sofreu ${threatCost} Ferimento(s) por Ameaça/Desespero` : `; sofreu ${threatCost} de Tensão por Ameaça/Desespero`;
            }
            else if (Number(check.netAdvantage || 0) > 0 && !criticalResult?.added) {
                nextCombat.pendingNpcBoost = 1;
                targetText += '; 1 Impulso preparado para o próximo aliado';
            }
            nextCombat = encounter_mjs_1.updateAdversaryInCombat(nextCombat, updatedAdversary);
            nextCombat.lastNpcAttack = clone(attack);
            nextCombat.log.push({ type: 'TURNO_NPC', round: nextCombat.round, actorId: adversary.id, weapon: weapon.name, check: clone(check), summary: targetText });
            return {
                combat: nextCombat,
                character: nextCharacter,
                attack,
                damageResult,
                criticalResult,
                summary: { actorId: adversary.id, text: `${adversary.name}: ${targetText}.` }
            };
        }
        advancePlayerTurn({ rng = Math.random } = {}) {
            if (this.state.combat?.encounter?.slots?.length)
                return this.finishPlayerInitiativeTurn({ rng });
            const combat = combat_mjs_1.nextPlayerTurn(this.state.combat);
            let character = this.state.player.character ? critical_mjs_1.expirePlayerTurnCriticalEffects(this.state.player.character) : null;
            if (character)
                character = statusEffects_mjs_1.expireStatusTurn(character);
            this.commit('COMBAT_ACTION', { combat, character });
            return combat;
        }
        finishPlayerInitiativeTurn({ rng = Math.random } = {}) {
            let combat = this.state.combat;
            let character = this.state.player.character;
            const slot = encounter_mjs_1.currentSlot(combat);
            if (!slot || slot.side !== 'player' || !combat.encounter?.waitingForPlayer)
                throw new Error('Não há turno do jogador aguardando encerramento.');
            combat = encounter_mjs_1.completeCurrentSlot(combat, 'player', { summary: 'Turno do jogador concluído.' });
            character = critical_mjs_1.expirePlayerTurnCriticalEffects(character);
            character = statusEffects_mjs_1.expireStatusTurn(character);
            const progressed = this._processNpcTurnsUntilPlayer(combat, character, rng);
            combat = progressed.combat;
            character = progressed.character;
            this.commit('COMBAT_ACTION', { combat, character });
            return { combat, character, npcTurns: progressed.npcTurns };
        }
        finishCombat({ rng = Math.random, strainSkill = 'frialdad' } = {}) {
            const preCombat = clone(this.state.combat);
            const causalHookId = preCombat?.causalHookId ?? null;
            const causalOutcome = preCombat?.encounter?.outcome ?? null;
            const publishedAdventureContext = preCombat?.publishedAdventureContext ?? null;
            const persistentAdversaries = clone(preCombat?.adversaries ?? []).filter(a => this.state.world?.npcs?.[a.id]);
            const encounterAdversaries = clone(preCombat?.adversaries ?? []).map(a => ({ id: a.id, name: a.name, profileKey: a.profileKey ?? null, worldNpcId: a.worldNpcId ?? null, factionId: a.factionId ?? null, status: a.status ?? 'active', wounds: Number(a.wounds?.current ?? 0), strain: Number(a.strain?.current ?? 0), criticalCount: a.criticalInjuries?.length ?? 0 }));
            let combat = combat_mjs_1.endCombat(preCombat);
            let character = this.state.player.character;
            let recovery = null;
            if (character) {
                character = critical_mjs_1.expireEncounterCriticalEffects(character);
                character = statusEffects_mjs_1.expireStatusEncounter(character);
                recovery = recovery_mjs_1.recoverAfterEncounter(character, { skillKey: strainSkill, rng });
                character = recovery.character;
            }
            this.commit('COMBAT_ACTION', { combat, character });
            if (persistentAdversaries.length) {
                let world = clone(this.state.world);
                for (const a of persistentAdversaries) {
                    world = world_mjs_1.setNpcCombatState(world, a.id, { profileKey: a.profileKey, kind: a.kind, wounds: a.wounds, strain: a.strain, criticalInjuries: a.criticalInjuries, status: a.status });
                    if (a.status === 'incapacitated')
                        world = world_mjs_1.setNpcStatus(world, a.id, 'incapacitado');
                }
                this.commit('WORLD_UPDATED', { world });
            }
            let resolvedWorldHook = null;
            let encounterRecord = null;
            let aftermath = null;
            if (causalOutcome) {
                const resolution = causalOutcome === 'adversaries_defeated' ? 'Conflito encerrado: adversários derrotados.' : causalOutcome === 'player_incapacitated' ? 'Conflito encerrado: jogador incapacitado.' : `Conflito encerrado: ${causalOutcome}.`;
                const recorded = world_mjs_1.recordEncounterOutcome(this.state.world, { hookId: causalHookId, outcome: causalOutcome, summary: resolution, rounds: Number(preCombat.round ?? 0), adversaries: encounterAdversaries });
                let world = recorded.world;
                encounterRecord = recorded.encounter;
                aftermath = recorded.aftermath;
                if (causalHookId) {
                    world = world_mjs_1.resolveWorldHook(world, causalHookId, { resolution });
                    resolvedWorldHook = world.hooks.find(h => h.id === causalHookId) ?? null;
                }
                this.commit('WORLD_UPDATED', { world });
            }
            let publishedAdventureOutcome = null;
            if (publishedAdventureContext?.adventureId) {
                const adapter = publishedAdventureRegistry_mjs_1.getPublishedAdventureAdapter(publishedAdventureContext.adventureId);
                const published = adapter.recordEncounterOutcome(this.state.world, { encounterId: publishedAdventureContext.encounterId, outcome: causalOutcome ?? 'ended', adversaries: encounterAdversaries });
                this.commit('WORLD_UPDATED', { world: published.world });
                publishedAdventureOutcome = published.record;
            }
            if (this.state.session?.status === 'ativa')
                this.commit('SESSION_COMBAT_ENDED', { session: sessionFlow_mjs_1.noteSessionCombatEnded(this.state.session) });
            return { combat, recovery, resolvedWorldHook, causalOutcome, encounterRecord, aftermath, publishedAdventureOutcome };
        }
        useAction(label = 'Ação') {
            let character = this.state.player.character;
            const critical = assertCanPerformAction(character);
            assertPlayerInitiativeTurn(this.state.combat);
            const combat = combat_mjs_1.spendAction(this.state.combat, label);
            character = applyActionCriticalStrain(character, critical);
            this.commit('COMBAT_ACTION', { combat, character });
            return combat;
        }
        useManeuver({ method = 'normal', label = 'Manobra' } = {}) {
            let character = this.state.player.character;
            assertCanAct(character);
            assertPlayerInitiativeTurn(this.state.combat);
            const status = statusEffects_mjs_1.statusModifiers(character);
            if (status.cannotManeuver)
                throw new Error('O personagem está immobilized e não pode realizar manobras agora.');
            const critical = assertCriticalManeuverAllowed(character, this.state.combat, method);
            const burden = encumbrance_mjs_1.encumbranceStatus(character);
            const used = Number(this.state.combat?.playerTurn?.maneuversUsed ?? 0);
            if (burden.severelyEncumbered && used === 0 && method === 'normal')
                throw new Error('A carga elimina a manobra gratuita; use a ação ou sofra 2 de Tensão.');
            let movement = combat_mjs_1.spendManeuver(this.state.combat, { method: used === 0 ? 'normal' : method, label });
            let strainCost = movement.strainCost;
            if (burden.severelyEncumbered && used === 0) {
                if (method === 'strain')
                    strainCost += 2;
                else if (method === 'action') {
                    if (movement.combat.playerTurn.actionUsed)
                        throw new Error('A ação já foi usada.');
                    movement.combat.playerTurn.actionUsed = true;
                }
            }
            if (strainCost > 0)
                character = health_mjs_1.sufferStrain(character, strainCost).character;
            this.commit('COMBAT_ACTION', { combat: movement.combat, character });
            return { combat: movement.combat, character, strainCost, encumbrance: burden, critical };
        }
        resolveSuggestedMasterCheck({ rng = Math.random } = {}) {
            const suggested = this.state.master?.suggestedCheck;
            if (!suggested)
                throw new Error('O Mestre não sugeriu nenhum teste agora.');
            const check = this.resolveSkillCheck({ ...suggested, rng });
            const next = structuredClone(this.state);
            next.master.suggestedCheck = null;
            this.state = next;
            this.repository.save(this.state);
            return check;
        }
        resolveSkillCheck({ skillKey, difficulty = 2, challenge = 0, boost = 0, setback = 0, gearAssist = null, useExpertTalent = false, useLightDestiny = false, usePlayerDestiny = false, useDarkDestiny = false, rng = Math.random }) {
            let character = this.state.player.character;
            useLightDestiny = Boolean(useLightDestiny || usePlayerDestiny);
            let actionCritical = assertCanPerformAction(character);
            assertPlayerInitiativeTurn(this.state.combat);
            const characteristicKey = character_mjs_1.SKILLS[skillKey];
            if (!characteristicKey || !(skillKey in character.skills))
                throw new Error('Perícia não disponível nesta ficha.');
            const status = statusEffects_mjs_1.statusModifiers(character, { consumeNextCheck: true });
            character = status.character;
            let combat = this.state.combat;
            if (combat.active)
                combat = combat_mjs_1.spendAction(combat, `Usar ${skillKey}`);
            const expert = talents_mjs_1.expertSkillTalentSpec(character, skillKey);
            let effectiveDifficulty = Number(difficulty);
            let expertTalent = null;
            if (useExpertTalent) {
                if (actionCritical.cannotVoluntarilySufferStrain)
                    throw new Error('O Ferimento Crítico impede sofrer Tensão voluntariamente para usar este talento.');
                if (!expert.available)
                    throw new Error('Esta perícia não possui um talento especialista disponível na ficha.');
                if (combat.active && combat.playerTurn?.expertSkillTalentUsed)
                    throw new Error('O talento especialista desta rodada já foi usado.');
                character = health_mjs_1.sufferStrain(character, expert.strainCost).character;
                assertCanAct(character);
                effectiveDifficulty = Math.max(expert.minDifficulty, effectiveDifficulty - expert.difficultyReduction);
                if (combat.active)
                    combat.playerTurn.expertSkillTalentUsed = true;
                expertTalent = { ...expert, used: true, effectiveDifficulty };
            }
            const critical = critical_mjs_1.criticalCheckModifiers(character, { skillKey, characteristicKey, consume: true });
            character = critical.character;
            const effectiveCharacteristic = Math.max(0, Number(character.characteristics[characteristicKey] ?? 0) - Number(critical.characteristicPenalty ?? 0));
            let positive = narrativeDice_mjs_1.buildPositivePool(effectiveCharacteristic, character.skills[skillKey]);
            if (useLightDestiny) {
                positive = destiny_mjs_1.upgradePositivePool(positive, 1);
                const group = destiny_mjs_1.flipDestiny(this.state.group, 'light');
                this.commit('GROUP_UPDATED', { group });
            }
            effectiveDifficulty += Number(critical.difficultyIncrease ?? 0) + Number(status.difficultyIncrease ?? 0);
            let criticalDifficulty = difficultyWithUpgrades(effectiveDifficulty, Number(challenge), Number(critical.difficultyUpgrades ?? 0));
            if (useDarkDestiny) {
                criticalDifficulty = destiny_mjs_1.upgradeNegativePool(criticalDifficulty, 1);
                const group = destiny_mjs_1.flipDestiny(this.state.group, 'dark');
                this.commit('GROUP_UPDATED', { group });
            }
            const baseSetback = Number(setback);
            let gearModifier = null;
            if (gearAssist) {
                if (gearAssist.itemId === 'tool_kit') {
                    if (skillKey !== 'mecanica')
                        throw new Error('Kit de ferramentas só pode aliviar a penalização auditada de Mecânica.');
                    gearModifier = generalGearEffects_mjs_1.mechanicsToolSetbackRelief(gearAssist.itemId, { setback: baseSetback, missingToolsSetback: gearAssist.missingToolsSetback ?? 0 });
                }
                else {
                    gearModifier = generalGearEffects_mjs_1.opticalSetbackRelief(gearAssist.itemId, { setback: baseSetback, longRangeSetback: gearAssist.longRangeSetback ?? 0, poorLightingSetback: gearAssist.poorLightingSetback ?? 0 });
                }
            }
            const environmentalSetback = gearModifier ? gearModifier.remainingSetback : baseSetback;
            const burdenSetback = encumbrance_mjs_1.encumbranceSetback(character, characteristicKey);
            const talentModifiers = talents_mjs_1.talentSkillPoolModifiers(character, skillKey, { boost: Number(boost) + Number(status.boost ?? 0), setback: environmentalSetback + critical.setback + Number(status.setback ?? 0) + burdenSetback });
            const check = {
                ...narrativeDice_mjs_1.rollPool({
                    ...positive,
                    difficulty: criticalDifficulty.difficulty,
                    challenge: criticalDifficulty.challenge,
                    boost: critical.removeBoost ? 0 : talentModifiers.boost,
                    setback: talentModifiers.setback
                }, rng),
                talentModifiers,
                gearModifier,
                expertTalent
            };
            character = applyActionCriticalStrain(character, critical);
            this.commit('COMBAT_ACTION', { combat, character, check });
            if (this.state.session?.status === 'ativa')
                this.commit('SESSION_CHECK_RESOLVED', { session: sessionFlow_mjs_1.noteSessionCheck(this.state.session) });
            return check;
        }
        resolveCheck({ characteristic, skill, difficulty = 2, challenge = 0, boost = 0, setback = 0, rng = Math.random }) {
            const positive = narrativeDice_mjs_1.buildPositivePool(characteristic, skill);
            const result = narrativeDice_mjs_1.rollPool({ ...positive, difficulty: Number(difficulty), challenge: Number(challenge), boost: Number(boost), setback: Number(setback) }, rng);
            this.commit('CHECK_RESOLVED', result);
            if (this.state.session?.status === 'ativa')
                this.commit('SESSION_CHECK_RESOLVED', { session: sessionFlow_mjs_1.noteSessionCheck(this.state.session) });
            return result;
        }
        resolveWeaponAttack({ weaponIndex = 0, targetAdversaryId = null, targetRange = null, difficulty = 2, challenge = 0, boost = 0, setback = 0, useLightDestiny = false, useDarkDestiny = false, rng = Math.random }) {
            let character = this.state.player.character;
            assertCanPerformAction(character);
            assertPlayerInitiativeTurn(this.state.combat);
            const weapon = character.weapons?.[Number(weaponIndex)];
            if (!weapon)
                throw new Error('Arma inválida.');
            const characteristicKey = character_mjs_1.SKILLS[weapon.skill];
            if (!characteristicKey)
                throw new Error('A perícia desta arma ainda não está mapeada.');
            const status = statusEffects_mjs_1.statusModifiers(character, { consumeNextCheck: true });
            character = status.character;
            let combat = this.state.combat;
            if (combat.active)
                combat = combat_mjs_1.spendAction(combat, `Ataque: ${weapon.name}`);
            const critical = critical_mjs_1.criticalCheckModifiers(character, { skillKey: weapon.skill, characteristicKey, consume: true });
            character = critical.character;
            const effectiveCharacteristic = Math.max(0, Number(character.characteristics[characteristicKey] ?? 0) - Number(critical.characteristicPenalty ?? 0));
            let positive = narrativeDice_mjs_1.buildPositivePool(effectiveCharacteristic, character.skills[weapon.skill] ?? 0);
            if (useLightDestiny) {
                positive = destiny_mjs_1.upgradePositivePool(positive, 1);
                const group = destiny_mjs_1.flipDestiny(this.state.group, 'light');
                this.commit('GROUP_UPDATED', { group });
            }
            const targetAdversary = targetAdversaryId ? combat.adversaries?.find(a => a.id === targetAdversaryId) : null;
            if (targetAdversaryId && !targetAdversary)
                throw new Error('Alvo do encontro não encontrado.');
            if (targetAdversary && adversaries_mjs_1.adversaryHealthStatus(targetAdversary).incapacitated)
                throw new Error('Esse adversário já está incapacitado.');
            const resolvedRange = targetAdversary ? targetAdversary.range : targetRange;
            const automaticDifficulty = resolvedRange ? attackDifficulty_mjs_1.attackDifficultyForWeapon(weapon, resolvedRange) : Number(difficulty);
            const upgrades = targetAdversary ? adversaries_mjs_1.upgradeDifficultyForAdversaryTalent(targetAdversary) : 0;
            let upgraded = difficultyWithUpgrades(automaticDifficulty + Number(critical.difficultyIncrease ?? 0) + Number(status.difficultyIncrease ?? 0), Number(challenge), upgrades + Number(critical.difficultyUpgrades ?? 0));
            if (useDarkDestiny) {
                upgraded = destiny_mjs_1.upgradeNegativePool(upgraded, 1);
                const group = destiny_mjs_1.flipDestiny(this.state.group, 'dark');
                this.commit('GROUP_UPDATED', { group });
            }
            const quickStrike = targetAdversary ? talents_mjs_1.quickStrikeBoost(character, { targetActorId: targetAdversary.id, actedActorIds: combat.encounter?.actedActorIds ?? [] }) : { rank: 0, boost: 0, applies: false };
            const totalBoost = Number(boost) + Number(status.boost ?? 0) + Number(combat.pendingAttackBoost ?? 0) + Number(quickStrike.boost ?? 0);
            const check = { ...narrativeDice_mjs_1.rollPool({
                    ...positive,
                    difficulty: upgraded.difficulty,
                    challenge: upgraded.challenge,
                    boost: critical.removeBoost ? 0 : totalBoost,
                    setback: Number(setback) + critical.setback + Number(status.setback ?? 0) + encumbrance_mjs_1.encumbranceSetback(character, characteristicKey)
                }, rng), quickStrike };
            let attack = { ...weapons_mjs_1.resolveWeaponHit(weapon, check), targetRange: resolvedRange, difficulty: upgraded.difficulty, challenge: upgraded.challenge, quickStrikeBoost: quickStrike.boost };
            const talentDamageBonus = attack.hit ? talents_mjs_1.talentCloseRangeDamageBonus(character, { weapon, targetRange: resolvedRange }) : 0;
            if (talentDamageBonus > 0)
                attack = { ...attack, damage: attack.damage + talentDamageBonus, talentDamageBonus };
            else
                attack = { ...attack, talentDamageBonus: 0 };
            combat = clone(combat);
            combat.pendingAttackBoost = 0;
            combat.pendingPlayerCritical = null;
            let targetDamage = null;
            if (targetAdversary && attack.hit) {
                targetDamage = adversaries_mjs_1.applyAdversaryDamage(targetAdversary, { damage: attack.damage, pierce: attack.pierce, damageType: attack.damageType });
                combat = encounter_mjs_1.updateAdversaryInCombat(combat, targetDamage.adversary);
                if (targetDamage.suffered > 0 && attack.criticalAvailable && !targetDamage.status.incapacitated) {
                    combat.pendingPlayerCritical = { adversaryId: targetAdversary.id, weapon: weapon.name, cost: attack.criticalCost, byTriumph: Boolean(attack.criticalByTriumph) };
                }
                attack = { ...attack, targetAdversaryId: targetAdversary.id, targetName: targetAdversary.name, targetDamage };
            }
            character = applyActionCriticalStrain(character, critical);
            this.commit('COMBAT_ACTION', { combat, character, check, attack });
            return attack;
        }
        activatePendingPlayerCritical() {
            let combat = clone(this.state.combat);
            const pending = combat.pendingPlayerCritical;
            if (!pending)
                throw new Error('Não há Ferimento Crítico disponível para ativar.');
            const target = combat.adversaries.find(a => a.id === pending.adversaryId);
            if (!target)
                throw new Error('O alvo do crítico não está mais no encontro.');
            const result = adversaries_mjs_1.applyAdversaryCritical(target, `Crítico ativado por ${this.state.player.character?.name ?? 'PJ'}`);
            combat = encounter_mjs_1.updateAdversaryInCombat(combat, result.adversary);
            combat.pendingPlayerCritical = null;
            combat.log.push({ type: 'CRITICO_ATIVADO', round: combat.round, targetId: target.id, woundsAdded: result.woundsAdded });
            this.commit('COMBAT_UPDATED', { combat });
            return result;
        }
        applyPlayerDamage({ damage, pierce = 0, damageType = 'wounds', reason = 'Dano recebido', criticalRng = Math.random }) {
            const character = this.state.player.character;
            const result = health_mjs_1.applyDamage(character, { damage: Number(damage), pierce: Number(pierce), damageType, reason, criticalRng });
            this.commit('CHARACTER_UPDATED', { character: result.character });
            return result;
        }
        sufferPlayerStrain(amount) {
            const result = health_mjs_1.sufferStrain(this.state.player.character, Number(amount));
            this.commit('CHARACTER_UPDATED', { character: result.character });
            return result;
        }
        usePlayerStimpack({ maneuverMethod = 'normal' } = {}) {
            let character = this.state.player.character;
            let combat = this.state.combat;
            assertCanAct(character);
            assertPlayerInitiativeTurn(combat);
            if (combat.active) {
                assertCriticalManeuverAllowed(character, combat, maneuverMethod);
                const movement = combat_mjs_1.spendManeuver(combat, { method: maneuverMethod, label: 'Usar injetor de estimulantes' });
                combat = movement.combat;
                if (movement.strainCost > 0)
                    character = health_mjs_1.sufferStrain(character, movement.strainCost).character;
            }
            const result = health_mjs_1.useStimpack(character);
            character = result.character;
            this.commit('COMBAT_ACTION', { combat, character });
            return { ...result, combat };
        }
        aim({ maneuverMethod = 'normal' } = {}) {
            let character = this.state.player.character;
            assertCanAct(character);
            assertPlayerInitiativeTurn(this.state.combat);
            assertCriticalManeuverAllowed(character, this.state.combat, maneuverMethod);
            const movement = combat_mjs_1.spendManeuver(this.state.combat, { method: maneuverMethod, label: 'Mirar' });
            let combat = movement.combat;
            if (movement.strainCost > 0)
                character = health_mjs_1.sufferStrain(character, movement.strainCost).character;
            combat.pendingAttackBoost = Number(combat.pendingAttackBoost ?? 0) + 1;
            this.commit('COMBAT_ACTION', { combat, character });
            return { combat, character, strainCost: movement.strainCost };
        }
        useMedicine({ medicalSupplies = true, medicalItemId = null, rng = Math.random } = {}) {
            let character = this.state.player.character;
            assertCanPerformAction(character);
            assertPlayerInitiativeTurn(this.state.combat);
            if (this.state.combat.active && this.state.combat.medicineUsed)
                throw new Error('A tentativa de Medicina deste encontro já foi usada.');
            let combat = this.state.combat.active ? combat_mjs_1.spendAction(this.state.combat, 'Medicina') : clone(this.state.combat);
            const medSkillKey = character?.creation?.speciesKey === 'droid' ? 'mecanica' : 'medicina';
            const medCharacteristic = character_mjs_1.SKILLS[medSkillKey];
            const critical = critical_mjs_1.criticalCheckModifiers(character, { skillKey: medSkillKey, characteristicKey: medCharacteristic, consume: true });
            character = critical.character;
            const result = recovery_mjs_1.resolveMedicineCheck(character, character, { medicalSupplies, medicalItemId, setback: critical.setback, difficultyIncrease: critical.difficultyIncrease, difficultyUpgrades: critical.difficultyUpgrades, characteristicPenalty: critical.characteristicPenalty, removeBoost: critical.removeBoost, rng });
            if (this.state.combat.active)
                combat.medicineUsed = true;
            result.character = applyActionCriticalStrain(result.character, critical);
            this.commit('COMBAT_ACTION', { combat, character: result.character, check: result.check });
            return result;
        }
        applyPlayerCritical(reason = 'Ferimento crítico', options = {}) {
            const character = requireCharacter(this.state.player.character);
            const result = critical_mjs_1.addStarterCritical(character, reason, options);
            if (result.added)
                this.commit('CHARACTER_UPDATED', { character: result.character });

        }
        restFullNight() {
            if (this.state.combat.active)
                throw new Error('Encerre o encontro antes de descansar uma noite completa.');
            const result = recovery_mjs_1.restFullNight(this.state.player.character);
            this.commit('CHARACTER_UPDATED', { character: result.character });

        healthStatus() {
            if (!this.state.player.character)

        }
        addVehicle(profileKey, { setActive = true, id = null, name = null } = {}) {
            const vehicles = clone(this.state.vehicles);

            vehicles.vehicles[vehicle.id] = vehicle;

        selectVehicle(vehicleId) {

        beginVehicleCombat({ targetProfileKey = 'tie_ln', range = 'Curto' } = {}) {
            const active = this.activeVehicle();
            if (!active)
                throw new Error('Selecione uma nave/veículo antes de iniciar o encontro.');
            const vehicles = clone(this.state.vehicles);
            const target = vehicles_mjs_1.createVehicleFromProfile(targetProfileKey, { id: `target_${targetProfileKey}` });
            vehicles.vehicles[target.id] = target;
            vehicles.combat = { ...vehicles.combat, active: true, round: 1, targetVehicleId: target.id, range, actionUsed: false, maneuversUsed: 0, lastAttack: null, log: [...(vehicles.combat.log ?? []), { type: 'INICIO_COMBATE_VEICULO', round: 1, targetId: target.id }] };
            this.commit('VEHICLES_UPDATED', { vehicles });
            return vehicles.combat;
        }
        endVehicleCombat() {
            const vehicles = clone(this.state.vehicles);
            vehicles.combat = { ...vehicles.combat, active: false, round: 0, targetVehicleId: null, actionUsed: false, maneuversUsed: 0, lastAttack: null };
            for (const v of Object.values(vehicles.vehicles ?? {}))
                if (v?.roundEffects) {
                    const base = vehicles_mjs_1.STARTER_VEHICLE_PROFILES[v.key]?.speedMax;
                    if (Number.isFinite(base)) {
                        v.speedMax = base;
                        v.speed = Math.min(v.speed, v.speedMax);
                    }
                    v.roundEffects = { evasive: false, stayOnTarget: false, enfiladeTargetId: null, controlledFire: false };
                }
            this.commit('VEHICLES_UPDATED', { vehicles });
            return vehicles.combat;
        }
        nextVehicleRound() {
            const vehicles = clone(this.state.vehicles);
            if (!vehicles.combat.active)
                throw new Error('Não há combate de naves/veículos ativo.');
            vehicles.combat.round = Math.max(1, Number(vehicles.combat.round || 1) + 1);
            vehicles.combat.actionUsed = false;
            vehicles.combat.maneuversUsed = 0;
            let active = vehicles.vehicles[vehicles.activeVehicleId];
            if (active) {
                const expired = vehicles_mjs_1.expireFullThrottle(active, vehicles.combat.round);
                active = vehicles_mjs_1.expireVehicleCriticalRound(expired.vehicle, vehicles.combat.round);
                const ft = active.roundEffects?.fullThrottle ?? null;
                active.roundEffects = { evasive: false, stayOnTarget: false, enfiladeTargetId: null, controlledFire: false, ...(ft ? { fullThrottle: ft } : {}) };
                vehicles.vehicles[active.id] = active;
            }
            let target = vehicles.vehicles[vehicles.combat.targetVehicleId];
            if (target) {
                const expired = vehicles_mjs_1.expireFullThrottle(target, vehicles.combat.round);
                target = vehicles_mjs_1.expireVehicleCriticalRound(expired.vehicle, vehicles.combat.round);
                const ft = target.roundEffects?.fullThrottle ?? null;
                target.roundEffects = { evasive: false, stayOnTarget: false, enfiladeTargetId: null, controlledFire: false, ...(ft ? { fullThrottle: ft } : {}) };
                vehicles.vehicles[target.id] = target;
            }
            this.commit('VEHICLES_UPDATED', { vehicles });
            return vehicles.combat;
        }
        useVehiclePilotManeuver(kind, { method = 'normal', direction = 'closer' } = {}) {
            const vehicles = clone(this.state.vehicles);
            const active = vehicles.vehicles?.[vehicles.activeVehicleId];
            if (!active)
                throw new Error('Nenhuma nave/veículo ativo.');
            const criticalStatus = vehicles_mjs_1.vehicleStatus(active, { currentRound: vehicles.combat.round });
            if (criticalStatus.destroyed)
                throw new Error('A nave/veículo foi destruída.');
            if (criticalStatus.noManeuvers)
                throw new Error('Um Critical Hit impede manobras da nave/veículo até ser resolvido ou reparado.');
            if (criticalStatus.tractorLocked && ['accelerate', 'brake', 'advance', 'punch_it', 'stop_short'].includes(kind))
                throw new Error(`Raio trator ativo: faça um teste de Pilotagem dificuldade ${criticalStatus.tractorDifficulty} antes de mover a nave/veículo.`);
            if (vehicles.combat.active) {
                const used = Number(vehicles.combat.maneuversUsed ?? 0);
                if (used >= 2)
                    throw new Error('A nave/veículo já recebeu 2 manobras exclusivas de piloto neste assalto.');
                if (used === 1) {
                    if (method === 'strain') {
                        if (!vehicles_mjs_1.canVoluntarilyInflictVehicleStrain(active))
                            throw new Error('Power Fluctuations impede sofrer Tensão de sistemas voluntariamente.');
                        active.systemStrain += 2;
                    }
                    else if (method === 'action') {
                        if (vehicles.combat.actionUsed)
                            throw new Error('A ação deste assalto já foi usada.');
                        vehicles.combat.actionUsed = true;
                    }
                    else
                        throw new Error('A segunda manobra exige 2 de Tensão de sistemas ou trocar a ação.');
                }
                vehicles.combat.maneuversUsed = used + 1;
            }
            let result = null;
            if (kind === 'accelerate')
                result = vehicles_mjs_1.accelerateOrBrake(active, 1);
            else if (kind === 'brake')
                result = vehicles_mjs_1.accelerateOrBrake(active, -1);
            else if (kind === 'advance') {
                vehicles.combat.range = vehicles_mjs_1.movePlanetaryRange(vehicles.combat.range, { direction, speed: active.speed });
                result = active;
            }
            else if (kind === 'evasive')
                result = vehicles_mjs_1.setEvasiveManeuvers(active, true);
            else if (kind === 'stay_on_target')
                result = vehicles_mjs_1.setStayOnTarget(active, true);
            else if (kind === 'punch_it') {
                const r = vehicles_mjs_1.punchIt(active);
                result = r.vehicle;
            }
            else if (kind === 'stop_short') {
                const r = vehicles_mjs_1.stopShort(active);
                result = r.vehicle;
            }
            else
                throw new Error('Manobra de nave/veículo desconhecida.');
            vehicles.vehicles[active.id] = result;
            vehicles.combat.log = [...(vehicles.combat.log ?? []), { type: 'MANOBRA_VEICULO', round: vehicles.combat.round, kind, vehicleId: active.id }];
            this.commit('VEHICLES_UPDATED', { vehicles });
            return { vehicle: result, combat: vehicles.combat, status: vehicles_mjs_1.vehicleStatus(result) };
        }
        useFullThrottle({ asManeuver = false, secondManeuverMethod = 'normal', skillKey = 'pilotar_vehiculo_espacial', rng = Math.random } = {}) {
            let character = requireCharacter(this.state.player.character);
            const vehicles = clone(this.state.vehicles);
            const active = vehicles.vehicles?.[vehicles.activeVehicleId];
            if (!active)
                throw new Error('Nenhuma nave/veículo ativo.');
            const criticalStatus = vehicles_mjs_1.vehicleStatus(active, { currentRound: vehicles.combat.round });
            if (criticalStatus.destroyed || criticalStatus.noManeuvers)
                throw new Error('Um Critical Hit impede esta manobra/ação de pilotagem.');
            if (!vehicles.combat.active)
                throw new Error('Aceleração máxima usa assaltos e exige um encontro de nave/veículo ativo.');
            if (asManeuver) {
                const used = Number(vehicles.combat.maneuversUsed ?? 0);
                if (used >= 2)
                    throw new Error('A nave/veículo já recebeu 2 manobras exclusivas de piloto neste assalto.');
                if (used === 1) {
                    if (secondManeuverMethod === 'strain') {
                        if (!vehicles_mjs_1.canVoluntarilyInflictVehicleStrain(active))
                            throw new Error('Power Fluctuations impede sofrer Tensão de sistemas voluntariamente.');
                        active.systemStrain += 2;
                    }
                    else if (secondManeuverMethod === 'action') {
                        if (vehicles.combat.actionUsed)
                            throw new Error('A ação deste assalto já foi usada.');
                        vehicles.combat.actionUsed = true;
                    }
                    else
                        throw new Error('A segunda manobra exige 2 de Tensão de sistemas ou trocar a ação.');
                }
                vehicles.combat.maneuversUsed = used + 1;
            }
            else {
                if (vehicles.combat.actionUsed)
                    throw new Error('A ação deste assalto já foi usada.');
                vehicles.combat.actionUsed = true;
            }
            const result = vehicles_mjs_1.attemptFullThrottle(active, character, { skillKey, asManeuver, currentRound: vehicles.combat.round, rng });
            if (result.personalStrainCost > 0)
                character = health_mjs_1.sufferStrain(character, result.personalStrainCost).character;
            vehicles.vehicles[active.id] = result.vehicle;
            vehicles.combat.log = [...(vehicles.combat.log ?? []), { type: 'ACELERACAO_MAXIMA', round: vehicles.combat.round, vehicleId: active.id, success: result.check.success, bonus: result.bonus, asManeuver }];
            this.commit('VEHICLES_UPDATED', { vehicles });
            if (result.personalStrainCost > 0)
                this.commit('CHARACTER_UPDATED', { character });
            return { ...result, character, combat: vehicles.combat };
        }
        useControlledFire() {
            throw new Error('Fogo controlado pertence ao legado Age of Rebellion e não faz parte das 18 especializações EotE Core ativas.');
        }
        resolveVehicleAttack({ weaponIndex = 0, facing = 'proa', rng = Math.random } = {}) {
            const character = requireCharacter(this.state.player.character);
            const vehicles = clone(this.state.vehicles);
            if (!vehicles.combat.active)
                throw new Error('Inicie um combate de naves/veículos.');
            if (vehicles.combat.actionUsed)
                throw new Error('A ação deste assalto já foi usada.');
            const attacker = vehicles.vehicles?.[vehicles.activeVehicleId], target = vehicles.vehicles?.[vehicles.combat.targetVehicleId];
            if (!attacker || !target)
                throw new Error('Atacante ou alvo de veículo ausente.');
            const attack = vehicles_mjs_1.resolveVehicleWeaponAttack({ character, attacker, target, facing, weaponIndex, targetRange: vehicles.combat.range, rng });
            vehicles.combat.actionUsed = true;
            vehicles.combat.lastAttack = attack;
            if (attack.targetDamage)
                vehicles.vehicles[target.id] = attack.targetDamage.vehicle;
            else if (attack.targetEffect?.vehicle)
                vehicles.vehicles[target.id] = attack.targetEffect.vehicle;
            vehicles.combat.log = [...(vehicles.combat.log ?? []), { type: 'ATAQUE_VEICULO', round: vehicles.combat.round, attackerId: attacker.id, targetId: target.id, hit: attack.hit, damage: attack.targetDamage?.suffered ?? 0, specialEffect: attack.targetEffect?.type ?? null }];
            this.commit('VEHICLES_UPDATED', { vehicles });
            return attack;
        }

        vehicleDamageControl({ boost = 0, setback = 0, rng = Math.random } = {}) {
            const character = requireCharacter(this.state.player.character);

            const talentModifiers = talents_mjs_1.talentSkillPoolModifiers(character, 'mecanica', { boost, setback });
            const check = { ...narrativeDice_mjs_1.rollPool({ ...positive, difficulty: diff, challenge: 0, boost: talentModifiers.boost, setback: talentModifiers.setback }, rng), talentModifiers };
            let repaired = { vehicle, systemStrainRecovered: 0, hullRecovered: 0 };
            if (check.netSuccess > 0)
                repaired = vehicles_mjs_1.applyDamageControl(vehicle, { successes: check.netSuccess, operator: character });
            vehicles.vehicles[vehicle.id] = repaired.vehicle;
            if (vehicles.combat.active)
                vehicles.combat.actionUsed = true;
            this.commit('VEHICLES_UPDATED', { vehicles });

        }
        applyActiveVehicleCritical({ roll = null, rng = Math.random, modifier = 0, component = null, defenseZone = 'proa', inAtmosphere = false } = {}) {

        vehiclePilotingHazardCheck({ boost = 0, setback = 0, rng = Math.random } = {}) {
            const character = requireCharacter(this.state.player.character);
            const vehicle = this.activeVehicle();
            if (!vehicle)
                throw new Error('Nave/veículo não encontrado.');
            const { difficulty, upgrades } = vehicles_mjs_1.pilotingHazardDifficulty(vehicle);
            const pool = vehicles_mjs_1.handlingPoolModifier(vehicle);
            const upgraded = difficultyWithUpgrades(difficulty, 0, upgrades);
            const positive = narrativeDice_mjs_1.buildPositivePool(character.characteristics.agilidad, character.skills.pilotar_vehiculo_espacial ?? 0);
            const talentModifiers = talents_mjs_1.talentSkillPoolModifiers(character, 'pilotar_vehiculo_espacial', { boost: Number(boost) + pool.boost, setback: Number(setback) + pool.setback });
            const criticalStatus = vehicles_mjs_1.vehicleStatus(vehicle, { currentRound: this.state.vehicles?.combat?.round ?? 0 });
            const recoveryDifficulty = criticalStatus.noManeuvers && Number(vehicles_mjs_1.vehicleCriticalModifiers(vehicle, { currentRound: this.state.vehicles?.combat?.round ?? 0 }).pilotRecoveryDifficulty ?? 0) > 0
                ? Number(vehicles_mjs_1.vehicleCriticalModifiers(vehicle, { currentRound: this.state.vehicles?.combat?.round ?? 0 }).pilotRecoveryDifficulty)
                : difficulty;
            const recoveryUpgraded = difficultyWithUpgrades(recoveryDifficulty, 0, upgrades);
            const check = { ...narrativeDice_mjs_1.rollPool({ ...positive, ...recoveryUpgraded, boost: talentModifiers.boost, setback: talentModifiers.setback }, rng), talentModifiers };
            this.commit('CHECK_RESOLVED', check);
            if (check.success && criticalStatus.noManeuvers) {
                const vehicles = clone(this.state.vehicles);
                const recovered = vehicles_mjs_1.clearKnockedOffCourse(vehicles.vehicles[vehicle.id]);
                vehicles.vehicles[vehicle.id] = recovered;
                this.commit('VEHICLES_UPDATED', { vehicles });
            }
            return { check, difficulty: recoveryDifficulty, upgrades, talentModifiers };
        }
        attemptTractorEscape({ boost = 0, setback = 0, rng = Math.random } = {}) {

            const vehicles = clone(this.state.vehicles);
            const vehicle = vehicles.vehicles?.[vehicles.activeVehicleId];

            if (!result.skipped) {
                vehicles.vehicles[vehicle.id] = result.vehicle;
                this.commit('VEHICLES_UPDATED', { vehicles });
                this.commit('CHECK_RESOLVED', result.check);
            }
            return result;
        }
        plotHyperspaceCourse({ difficulty = 1, boost = 0, setback = 0, rng = Math.random } = {}) {
            const character = requireCharacter(this.state.player.character);
            const vehicle = this.activeVehicle();
            if (!vehicle)
                throw new Error('Nave/veículo não encontrado.');
            if (!vehicle.hyperdrive)
                throw new Error('Esta nave/veículo não possui hiperimpulsor.');
            const criticalStatus = vehicles_mjs_1.vehicleStatus(vehicle, { currentRound: this.state.vehicles?.combat?.round ?? 0 });
            if (criticalStatus.hyperspaceDisabled)
                throw new Error('Critical Hit: hiperimpulsor/computador de navegação inoperante até reparo.');
            if (!vehicle.navComputer && !vehicle.astromechPort)
                throw new Error('A nave não possui computador de navegação nem suporte astromecânico para calcular a rota.');
            const positive = narrativeDice_mjs_1.buildPositivePool(character.characteristics.intelecto, character.skills.astronavegacion ?? 0);
            const talentModifiers = talents_mjs_1.talentSkillPoolModifiers(character, 'astronavegacion', { boost, setback });
            const check = { ...narrativeDice_mjs_1.rollPool({ ...positive, difficulty: Number(difficulty), challenge: 0, boost: talentModifiers.boost, setback: talentModifiers.setback }, rng), talentModifiers };
            this.commit('CHECK_RESOLVED', check);
            const timeMultiplier = talents_mjs_1.galacticCartographerTimeMultiplier(character);
            return { check, difficulty: Number(difficulty), vehicleId: vehicle.id, talentModifiers, timeMultiplier };
        }
        adversaryProfiles() {

    function compactStoredEvent(event) {
        if (!event || typeof event !== 'object')
            return event;
        if (event.type !== 'WORLD_UPDATED' || !event.payload?.world)
            return structuredClone(event);
        const world = event.payload.world;
        if (world.counts && !('npcs' in world) && !('locations' in world) && !('factions' in world) && !('history' in world))
            return structuredClone(event);
        return {
            id: event.id,
            type: event.type,
            at: event.at,
            payload: {
                ...event.payload,
                world: {
                    schemaVersion: world.schemaVersion ?? null,

    function imageAssetRuntimeDescriptor(manifest, asset) {
        if (!asset)
            return null;
        if (asset.sourceType === 'external_reference') {

                sourcePageUrl: asset.sourcePageUrl || null,
                cachePolicy: asset.cachePolicy || 'explicit_on_demand',
                offlineReady: false,
            };
        }
        return {
            assetId: asset.assetId,
            mode: 'packaged',
            localPath: asset.localPath,
            offlineReady: true,
        };
    }

    const sourceAuthority_mjs_1 = require("../rag/sourceAuthority.mjs");
    function parseJson(value, fallback) {
        try {
            return JSON.parse(String(value ?? ''));
        }
        catch {
            return fallback;
        }
    }
    function nativeLibraryAvailable(bridge = globalThis.BraseiroLibrary) {
        return Boolean(bridge && typeof bridge.listDocuments === 'function' && typeof bridge.searchDocuments === 'function');
    }
    function listLibraryDocuments(bridge = globalThis.BraseiroLibrary) {
        if (!nativeLibraryAvailable(bridge))
            return [];
        const parsed = parseJson(bridge.listDocuments(), []);
        return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
    }
    function searchImportedLibrary(query, { limit = 5, bridge = globalThis.BraseiroLibrary } = {}) {
        const q = String(query ?? '').trim();
        if (!q || !nativeLibraryAvailable(bridge))
            return [];
        const parsed = parseJson(bridge.searchDocuments(q, Math.max(1, Math.min(20, Number(limit) || 5))), { results: [] });
        const rows = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : parsed?.results;
        if (!Array.isArray(rows))
            return [];
        // Disabled sources remain visible in the Library for explicit reactivation,
        // but never participate in the Mestre/RAG path. This keeps future adventure
        // packs out of the default sandbox until the user explicitly enables them.
        return rows.filter(row => row?.enabled !== false).map((row, index) => ({
            rank: index + 1,
            score: Number(row.score ?? 0),
            id: String(row.id ?? `LIB-${row.docId ?? index}`),
            title: String(row.title ?? row.fileName ?? 'PDF importado'),
            status: 'FONTE_IMPORTADA',
            summary: String(row.summary ?? row.excerpt ?? ''),
            inputs: 'Consulta textual em PDF importado',
            source: String(row.source ?? row.fileName ?? 'Biblioteca local'),
            edition: 'Importado pelo usuário',
            page: Number.isFinite(Number(row.page)) ? Number(row.page) : null,
            printedPage: null,
            function: null,
            test: null,
            official: null,
            sourceKind: 'library_pdf',
            documentId: row.docId ?? null,
            authorityType: (0, sourceAuthority_mjs_1.normalizeLibraryAuthority)(row.authorityType),
            authorityWeight: (0, sourceAuthority_mjs_1.libraryAuthorityWeight)(row.authorityType),
            enabled: row.enabled !== false
        }));
    }
    function updateLibraryDocumentPolicy(docId, { authorityType = 'SUPLEMENTO', enabled = true } = {}, bridge = globalThis.BraseiroLibrary) {
        if (!bridge || typeof bridge.setDocumentPolicy !== 'function')
            throw new Error('Ajuste de autoridade indisponível neste ambiente.');
        const normalized = (0, sourceAuthority_mjs_1.normalizeLibraryAuthority)(authorityType);
        const parsed = parseJson(bridge.setDocumentPolicy(String(docId ?? ''), normalized, Boolean(enabled)), { ok: false, message: 'Falha ao atualizar a fonte.' });
        if (!parsed?.ok)
            throw new Error(parsed?.message || 'Falha ao atualizar a fonte.');
        return parsed;
    }
    function libraryAuthorityTypeLabel(value) { return (0, sourceAuthority_mjs_1.libraryAuthorityLabel)(value); }
    function requestPdfImport(bridge = globalThis.BraseiroLibrary) {
        if (!bridge || typeof bridge.pickPdf !== 'function')
            throw new Error('A importação de PDF está disponível no aplicativo Android.');
        const parsed = parseJson(bridge.pickPdf(), { ok: false, message: 'Não foi possível abrir o seletor de PDF.' });
        if (parsed?.ok === false)
            throw new Error(parsed.message || 'Não foi possível abrir o seletor de PDF.');
        return parsed;
    }
    function reindexLibraryDocument(docId, bridge = globalThis.BraseiroLibrary) {
        if (!bridge || typeof bridge.reindexDocument !== 'function')

    }

        if (!bridge || typeof bridge.removeDocument !== 'function')
            throw new Error('Remoção indisponível neste ambiente.');
        const parsed = parseJson(bridge.removeDocument(String(docId ?? '')), { ok: false, message: 'Falha ao remover documento.' });
        if (!parsed?.ok)
            throw new Error(parsed?.message || 'Falha ao remover documento.');

    }
    function libraryStatusLabel(status) {
        const labels = {

        const parts = [state.scene?.title, state.scene?.narration, location?.name, location?.description, state.session?.phase, state.combat?.active ? 'combate' : '', state.vehicles?.combat?.active ? 'combate veicular combate espacial' : ''];
        return parts.filter(Boolean).join(' | ');
    }
    function scoreSceneAsset(asset, context) {
        const text = normalize(context);
        const tokenSet = words(context);
        let score = 0;
        const hits = [];
        const cue = CUES.find(c => c.assetId === asset.assetId);
        if (cue) {
            for (const raw of cue.terms) {
                const term = normalize(raw);
                const matched = term.includes(' ') ? text.includes(term) : tokenSet.has(term);
                if (matched) {
                    score += cue.weight + (term.includes(' ') ? 4 : 0);
                    hits.push(raw);
                }
            }
        }
        for (const tag of (asset.tags ?? [])) {
            const t = normalize(tag);
            if (t && tokenSet.has(t)) {
                score += 3;
                hits.push(`tag:${tag}`);
            }
        }
        if (asset.sceneMode === 'vehicle_combat' && /combate veicular|combate espacial|orbita|tie/.test(text))
            score += 20;
        if (asset.sceneMode === 'combat' && /combate|tiroteio|blaster|stormtrooper/.test(text))
            score += 10;
        if (asset.sceneMode === 'travel' && /viagem|hiperespaco|rota|salto|espacoporto|hangar/.test(text))
            score += 8;
        if (asset.sceneMode === 'social' && /social|cantina|bar|negocia|conversa/.test(text))
            score += 8;
        if (asset.sceneMode === 'exploration' && /explora|deserto|cidade|mercado|jundland|jedha/.test(text))
            score += 7;
        return { score, hits: [...new Set(hits)] };
    }
    function selectLocalSceneAsset(context, { manifest = imageLibraryData_mjs_1.IMAGE_LIBRARY_MANIFEST, minScore = 10 } = {}) {
        const ranked = sceneAssets(manifest).map(asset => ({ asset, ...scoreSceneAsset(asset, context) })).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || a.asset.assetId.localeCompare(b.asset.assetId));
        const best = ranked[0] ?? null;
        if (!best || best.score < minScore)
            return { asset: null, score: best?.score ?? 0, hits: best?.hits ?? [], fallback: 'gemini' };
        return { asset: best.asset, score: best.score, hits: best.hits, fallback: null };
    }
    function resolveSceneVisualForState(state, { manifest = imageLibraryData_mjs_1.IMAGE_LIBRARY_MANIFEST, minScore = 10 } = {}) {
        const existingId = String(state?.scene?.imageAssetId ?? '').trim();
        if (existingId) {
            const existing = (manifest.assets ?? []).find(a => a.assetId === existingId && a.category === 'scene') ?? null;
            if (existing)
                return { asset: existing, descriptor: imageLibrary_mjs_1.imageAssetRuntimeDescriptor(manifest, existing), source: state.scene?.imageSource ?? 'library', locked: Boolean(state.scene?.imageLocked), score: null, hits: [] };
        }
        const context = buildSceneVisualContext(state);
        const selected = selectLocalSceneAsset(context, { manifest, minScore });
        return { asset: selected.asset, descriptor: selected.asset ? imageLibrary_mjs_1.imageAssetRuntimeDescriptor(manifest, selected.asset) : null, source: selected.asset ? 'library' : 'gemini_fallback', locked: false, score: selected.score, hits: selected.hits, context };
    }
    function applyAutomaticSceneVisual(state, { manifest = imageLibraryData_mjs_1.IMAGE_LIBRARY_MANIFEST, minScore = 10 } = {}) {
        const next = structuredClone(state);
        next.scene = { title: 'Abertura', narration: '', locationId: null, imageAssetId: null, imageSource: null, imageLocked: false, imagePrompt: null, ...(next.scene ?? {}) };
        if (next.scene.imageLocked && next.scene.imageAssetId)
            return { state: next, changed: false, reason: 'locked' };
        const resolved = resolveSceneVisualForState({ ...next, scene: { ...next.scene, imageAssetId: null } }, { manifest, minScore });
        const assetId = resolved.asset?.assetId ?? null;
        const changed = next.scene.imageAssetId !== assetId || next.scene.imageSource !== (assetId ? 'library' : 'gemini_fallback');
        next.scene.imageAssetId = assetId;
        next.scene.imageSource = assetId ? 'library' : 'gemini_fallback';
        if (!assetId)
            next.scene.imagePrompt = buildSceneVisualContext(next);
        return { state: next, changed, reason: assetId ? 'local_match' : 'gemini_fallback', asset: resolved.asset, score: resolved.score, hits: resolved.hits };
    }

    function validateProviderEndpoint(endpoint) {
        const value = String(endpoint ?? '').trim();
        if (!value)
            throw new Error('Endpoint do Mestre não configurado.');
        let url;
        try {
            url = new URL(value);
        }
        catch {
            throw new Error('Endpoint do Mestre inválido.');
        }
        if (url.protocol !== 'https:' && !(url.protocol === 'http:' && ['127.0.0.1', 'localhost'].includes(url.hostname))) {
            throw new Error('O endpoint do Mestre deve usar HTTPS; HTTP só é aceito para localhost em desenvolvimento.');
        }
        return url.toString();
    }
    function providerRequestBody(context) {
        if (!context || typeof context !== 'object')
            throw new Error('Contexto do Mestre ausente.');
        return {
            protocol: 'braseiro.master.v1',
            instruction: 'Produza apenas uma proposta estruturada. Este VTT é um sandbox de mundo vivo: apresente situações, tensões, rumores e consequências sem roteiro obrigatório, sem missão forçada e sem conteúdo de aventura publicado carregado por padrão. Pacotes de aventura futuros serão extensões explícitas, nunca trilhos automáticos. Não altere ficha, combate ou estado diretamente. Para mudanças ficcionais persistentes, inclusive facções, agendas, oportunidades, relógios, mercados e afiliação de PNPCs, use somente worldOperations permitidas; o motor validará IDs e limites. NPCs e facções continuam agindo fora da cena quando o tempo avança. Não invente regra mecânica, preço, raridade, estatística ou valor numérico não fundamentado: para decisões mecânicas cite somente sourceRuleIds presentes em context.rules. Para pedidos explícitos do jogador por arma, armadura, equipamento ou veículo presentes em context.economy.catalog, use acquisitionRequest; não conclua a compra no mesmo turno. Recompensa, saque, presente ou furto de um ativo catalogado usa economyOperations grant_asset. Perda pode usar lose_asset; dano, reparo e venda exigem sourceRuleIds recuperados. Nunca escreva inventário diretamente. Se uma consequência causal de context.causalEncounters for narrada ou descartada, resolva-a com worldOperations resolve_hook. sceneLocationId só pode apontar para um local existente em context.world.locations.',
            context
        };
    }
    async function requestHttpMasterProposal({ endpoint, context, fetchImpl = globalThis.fetch, timeoutMs = 15000, signal = null } = {}) {
        if (typeof fetchImpl !== 'function')
            throw new Error('Cliente HTTP indisponível.');
        const url = validateProviderEndpoint(endpoint);
        const controller = new AbortController();
        const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(new Error('Tempo limite do Mestre excedido.')), Math.max(1, Number(timeoutMs) || 15000));
        const abort = () => controller.abort(signal?.reason ?? new Error('Solicitação do Mestre cancelada.'));
        if (signal) {
            if (signal.aborted)
                abort();
            else
                signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
        }
        try {
            const response = await fetchImpl(url, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify(providerRequestBody(context)),
                signal: controller.signal
            });
            if (!response?.ok)
                throw new Error(`Mestre remoto respondeu com HTTP ${response?.status ?? 'desconhecido'}.`);
            const data = await response.json();
            if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || !data.proposal || typeof data.proposal !== 'object')
                throw new Error('Resposta do Mestre remoto não contém uma proposta estruturada.');
            return { provider: 'http', proposal: data.proposal, meta: data.meta ?? null };
        }
        catch (error) {
            if (controller.signal.aborted)
                throw new Error(signal?.aborted ? 'Solicitação do Mestre cancelada.' : 'Tempo limite do Mestre excedido.');
            throw error;
        }
        finally {
            clearTimeout(timer);
            if (signal)
                signal.removeEventListener?.('abort', abort);
        }
    }
    function offlineMasterStatus(context) {
        return { provider: 'offline', available: false, contextDigest: { corpusVersion: context?.corpusVersion ?? null, grounded: context?.retrieval?.grounded ?? false, ruleIds: (context?.rules ?? []).map(r => r.id) } };
    }

        if (next.status !== 'ativa')
            return next;
        next.combatEncounters += 1;
        next.phase = 'conflito';
        return next;
    }
    function noteSessionCombatEnded(value) {
        const next = normalizeSessionRuntime(value);
        if (next.status !== 'ativa')
            return next;
        next.phase = 'recuperacao';
        return next;
    }
    function phaseAfterMasterProposal(proposal) {
        if (proposal?.suggestedCheck)
            return 'resolucao';
        if (proposal?.askPlayer)
            return 'decisao';
        return 'cena';
    }
    function closeSessionRuntime(value, { at = new Date().toISOString(), summary = '', xpAwarded = 0 } = {}) {
        const current = normalizeSessionRuntime(value);
        if (current.status !== 'ativa')
            throw new Error('Não há sessão ativa para encerrar.');
        const xp = Number(xpAwarded);
        if (!Number.isInteger(xp) || xp < 0 || xp > 1000)
            throw new Error('PE de encerramento inválidos.');
        return {
            ...current,
            status: 'encerrada',
            phase: 'encerrada',
            endedAt: at,
            xpAwarded: xp,
            summary: String(summary ?? '').trim() || 'Sessão encerrada sem resumo narrativo.'
        };
    }
    function buildDeterministicSessionSummary(state) {
        const s = normalizeSessionRuntime(state?.session);
        const character = state?.player?.character;
        const eventSlice = (state?.events ?? []).filter(e => {
            if (!s.startedAt)
                return false;
            return String(e.at ?? '') >= s.startedAt;
        });
        const intents = eventSlice.filter(e => e.type === 'PLAYER_INTENT').length;
        const combats = s.combatEncounters;
        const checks = s.checksResolved;
        const status = character
            ? `Ferimentos ${character.derived?.wounds?.current ?? 0}/${character.derived?.wounds?.threshold ?? 0}; Tensão ${character.derived?.strain?.current ?? 0}/${character.derived?.strain?.threshold ?? 0}.`
            : 'Sem personagem ativo.';
        return `Sessão ${s.number}: ${intents} ação(ões) declarada(s), ${checks} teste(s) resolvido(s), ${combats} encontro(s) de combate. ${status}`;
    }
    });
    define("js/rag/lexicalSearch.mjs",function(module,exports,require){
    "use strict";
    Object.defineProperty(exports, "__esModule", { value: true });
    exports.VERIFIED_CORPUS_GAPS = exports.RULE_CORPUS_VERSION = void 0;
    exports.normalizeSearchText = normalizeSearchText;
    exports.tokenize = tokenize;
    exports.verifiedCorpusGapForQuery = verifiedCorpusGapForQuery;
    exports.searchVerifiedRules = searchVerifiedRules;
    exports.ruleRetrievalStatus = ruleRetrievalStatus;
    const rulesCorpus_mjs_1 = require("./rulesCorpus.mjs");
    exports.RULE_CORPUS_VERSION = rulesCorpus_mjs_1.RULE_CORPUS_VERSION;
    const STOP = new Set(['a', 'o', 'as', 'os', 'de', 'da', 'do', 'das', 'dos', 'e', 'em', 'um', 'uma', 'para', 'por', 'com', 'como', 'que', 'qual', 'quais', 'no', 'na', 'nos', 'nas', 'me', 'eu', 'meu', 'minha', 'funciona', 'funcionar', 'regra', 'regras']);
    function normalizeSearchText(value = '') {
        return String(value).normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ').trim();
    }
    function tokenize(value = '') {
        return normalizeSearchText(value).split(/\s+/).filter(t => t.length > 1 && !STOP.has(t));
    }
    exports.VERIFIED_CORPUS_GAPS = Object.freeze([]);
    function verifiedCorpusGapForQuery(_query = '') {
        return null;
    }
    function searchable(doc) {
        return normalizeSearchText([doc.id, doc.title, doc.summary, doc.inputs, doc.source, doc.function].filter(Boolean).join(' '));
    }
    function idf(token, corpus) {
        let n = 0;
        for (const d of corpus)
            if (searchable(d).includes(token))
                n++;
        return Math.log(1 + corpus.length / (1 + n));
    }
    function searchVerifiedRules(query, { limit = 5, includePending = true, corpus = rulesCorpus_mjs_1.VERIFIED_RULE_CORPUS } = {}) {
        const q = normalizeSearchText(query);
        if (!q)
            return [];
        if (verifiedCorpusGapForQuery(query))
            return [];
        const tokens = tokenize(query);
        const scored = [];
        for (const doc of corpus) {
            if (!includePending && !['TESTADO', 'IMPLEMENTADO'].includes(doc.status))
                continue;
            const hay = searchable(doc);
            let score = 0;
            if (hay.includes(q))
                score += 8;
            for (const token of tokens) {
                if (!hay.includes(token))
                    continue;
                score += idf(token, corpus);
                if (normalizeSearchText(doc.title).includes(token))
                    score += 1.8;
                if (normalizeSearchText(doc.summary).includes(token))
                    score += 1.2;
                if (normalizeSearchText(doc.id).includes(token))
                    score += 0.8;
            }
            if (score > 0)
                scored.push({ doc, score });
        }
        return scored.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || a.doc.id.localeCompare(b.doc.id)).slice(0, limit).map((x, i) => ({ rank: i + 1, score: Number(x.score.toFixed(4)), ...structuredClone(x.doc) }));
    }
    function ruleRetrievalStatus(results = []) {
        if (!results.length)
            return { grounded: false, reason: 'Nenhuma regra pertinente foi encontrada no corpus auditado.' };
        const grounded = results.some(r => ['TESTADO', 'IMPLEMENTADO', 'FONTE_IMPORTADA'].includes(r.status) && r.summary && r.summary !== 'A_AUDITAR');
        return grounded
            ? { grounded: true, reason: 'Há evidência local pertinente no índice offline.' }
            : { grounded: false, reason: 'O índice encontrou uma lacuna ou regra ainda não auditada; o Mestre não deve preencher por memória.' };
    }
    });

    function aliveMinions(adversary) {
        if (adversary?.kind !== 'minion')
            return adversaryHealthStatus(adversary).incapacitated ? 0 : 1;
        const total = Number(adversary.membersTotal) || 0;
        const per = Number(adversary.wounds?.perMember) || 0;
        const current = Math.max(0, Number(adversary.wounds?.current) || 0);
        if (total < 1 || per < 1)
            return 0;
        const defeated = Math.min(total, current === 0 ? 0 : Math.floor((current - 1) / per));
        return Math.max(0, total - defeated);
    }
    function adversarySkillRank(adversary, skillKey) {
        if (!adversary)
            throw new Error('Adversário inválido.');
        if (!(skillKey in character_mjs_1.SKILLS))
            throw new Error('Perícia de adversário não mapeada.');
        if (adversary.kind === 'minion') {
            if (!adversary.groupSkills?.includes(skillKey))
                return 0;
            return Math.max(0, aliveMinions(adversary) - 1);
        }
        return Math.max(0, Number(adversary.skills?.[skillKey]) || 0);
    }
    function adversaryCharacteristicForSkill(adversary, skillKey) {
        const characteristic = character_mjs_1.SKILLS[skillKey];
        if (!characteristic)
            throw new Error('Perícia de adversário não mapeada.');
        return Number(adversary.characteristics?.[characteristic] ?? 0);
    }
    function adversaryHealthStatus(adversary) {
        if (!adversary?.wounds)
            throw new Error('Estado de adversário inválido.');
        const minionsAlive = adversary.kind === 'minion' ? aliveMinionsRaw(adversary) : null;
        const woundIncapacitated = adversary.kind === 'minion'
            ? minionsAlive <= 0
            : Number(adversary.wounds.current) > Number(adversary.wounds.threshold);
        const strainIncapacitated = adversary.kind === 'nemesis' && adversary.strain
            ? Number(adversary.strain.current) > Number(adversary.strain.threshold)
            : false;
        return {
            incapacitated: woundIncapacitated || strainIncapacitated,
            woundIncapacitated,
            strainIncapacitated,
            minionsAlive,
            label: woundIncapacitated || strainIncapacitated ? 'Incapacitado' : 'Ativo'
        };
    }
    function aliveMinionsRaw(adversary) {
        const total = Number(adversary.membersTotal) || 0;
        const per = Number(adversary.wounds?.perMember) || 0;
        const current = Math.max(0, Number(adversary.wounds?.current) || 0);
        if (total < 1 || per < 1)
            return 0;
        const defeated = Math.min(total, current === 0 ? 0 : Math.floor((current - 1) / per));
        return Math.max(0, total - defeated);
    }
    function applyAdversaryDamage(adversary, { damage, pierce = 0, damageType = 'wounds' } = {}) {
        if (!adversary)
            throw new Error('Adversário inválido.');
        const raw = Number(damage), p = Number(pierce);
        if (!Number.isInteger(raw) || raw < 0)
            throw new Error('Dano inválido.');
        if (!Number.isInteger(p) || p < 0)
            throw new Error('Perfuração inválida.');
        if (!['wounds', 'strain'].includes(damageType))
            throw new Error('Tipo de dano inválido.');
        const next = clone(adversary);
        const effectiveSoak = Math.max(0, Number(next.soak) - p);
        const suffered = Math.max(0, raw - effectiveSoak);
        const convertedToWounds = damageType === 'strain' && next.kind !== 'nemesis';
        if (damageType === 'strain' && next.kind === 'nemesis')
            next.strain.current += suffered;
        else
            next.wounds.current += suffered;
        const status = adversaryHealthStatus(next);
        next.status = status.incapacitated ? 'incapacitated' : 'active';
        return { adversary: next, rawDamage: raw, effectiveSoak, suffered, damageType: convertedToWounds ? 'wounds' : damageType, convertedToWounds, status };
    }
    function sufferAdversaryStrain(adversary, amount) {
        const n = Number(amount);
        if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 0)
            throw new Error('Quantidade de Tensão inválida.');
        const next = clone(adversary);
        if (next.kind === 'nemesis' && next.strain) {
            next.strain.current += n;
            const status = adversaryHealthStatus(next);
            next.status = status.incapacitated ? 'incapacitated' : 'active';
            return { adversary: next, amount: n, convertedToWounds: false, status };
        }
        next.wounds.current += n;
        const status = adversaryHealthStatus(next);
        next.status = status.incapacitated ? 'incapacitated' : 'active';
        return { adversary: next, amount: n, convertedToWounds: true, status };
    }
    function applyAdversaryCritical(adversary, reason = 'Ferimento crítico') {
        const next = clone(adversary);
        if (next.kind === 'minion') {
            const alive = aliveMinionsRaw(next);
            if (alive <= 0)
                return { adversary: next, applied: false, woundsAdded: 0, status: adversaryHealthStatus(next) };
            const per = next.wounds.perMember;
            const defeated = next.membersTotal - alive;
            const target = per * (defeated + 1) + 1;
            const add = Math.max(1, target - next.wounds.current);
            next.wounds.current += add;
            const status = adversaryHealthStatus(next);
            next.status = status.incapacitated ? 'incapacitated' : 'active';
            return { adversary: next, applied: true, woundsAdded: add, status };
        }
        next.criticalInjuries.push({ id: (0, ids_mjs_1.newId)('advcrit'), reason, at: new Date().toISOString() });
        return { adversary: next, applied: true, woundsAdded: 0, status: adversaryHealthStatus(next) };
    }
    function upgradeDifficultyForAdversaryTalent(adversary) {
        return Math.max(0, Number(adversary?.talents?.find(t => t.key === 'adversario')?.rank) || 0);
    }
