    function attemptFullThrottle(vehicle, character, { skillKey = 'pilotar_vehiculo_espacial', asManeuver = false, currentRound = 1, rng = Math.random } = {}) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        const spec = (0, talents_mjs_1.fullThrottleTalentSpec)(character);
        if (!spec.available)
            throw new Error('O personagem não possui Aceleração máxima.');
        if (asManeuver && !spec.improved)
            throw new Error('Aceleração máxima como manobra exige Aceleração máxima aprimorada.');
        const characteristic = Number(character?.characteristics?.agilidad ?? 0);
        const rank = Number(character?.skills?.[skillKey] ?? 0);
        const positive = (0, narrativeDice_mjs_1.buildPositivePool)(characteristic, rank);
        const difficulty = asManeuver ? spec.maneuverDifficulty : spec.actionDifficulty;
        const check = (0, narrativeDice_mjs_1.rollPool)({ ...positive, difficulty, challenge: 0, boost: 0, setback: 0 }, rng);
        const next = clone(vehicle);
        const rounds = Math.max(1, Number(character?.characteristics?.astucia ?? 1));
        if (check.success) {
            const baseMax = Number(exports.STARTER_VEHICLE_PROFILES[next.key]?.speedMax ?? next.speedMax);
            next.speedMax = baseMax + spec.bonus;
            next.roundEffects = { ...(next.roundEffects ?? {}), fullThrottle: { bonus: spec.bonus, expiresAfterRound: Number(currentRound) + rounds - 1 } };
        }
        return { vehicle: next, check, difficulty, bonus: check.success ? spec.bonus : 0, durationRounds: check.success ? rounds : 0, personalStrainCost: asManeuver ? spec.improvedStrainCost : 0, spec };
    }
    function expireFullThrottle(vehicle, currentRound) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        const next = clone(vehicle);
        const effect = next.roundEffects?.fullThrottle;
        if (!effect)
            return { vehicle: next, expired: false };
        if (Number(currentRound) <= Number(effect.expiresAfterRound))
            return { vehicle: next, expired: false };
        const baseMax = Number(exports.STARTER_VEHICLE_PROFILES[next.key]?.speedMax ?? Math.max(0, next.speedMax - Number(effect.bonus || 0)));
        next.speedMax = baseMax;
        next.speed = Math.min(next.speed, next.speedMax);
        delete next.roundEffects.fullThrottle;
        return { vehicle: next, expired: true };
    }
    function gunneryDifficultyBySilhouette(attackerSilhouette, targetSilhouette) {
        const a = int(attackerSilhouette, 'Silhueta atacante', { min: 0, max: 10 }), t = int(targetSilhouette, 'Silhueta alvo', { min: 0, max: 10 });
        const diff = a - t;
        if (Math.abs(diff) <= 1)
            return 2;
        if (diff <= -2)
            return 1;
        if (diff === 2)
            return 3;
        return 4;
    }
    function enfiladeDifficulty(attackerSpeed, targetSpeed) {
        const a = int(attackerSpeed, 'Velocidade atacante', { min: 0, max: 9 }), t = int(targetSpeed, 'Velocidade alvo', { min: 0, max: 9 });
        if (a === t)
            return 2;
        if (a > t)
            return 1;
        if (t - a === 1)
            return 3;
        return 4;
    }
    function pilotingHazardDifficulty(vehicle) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        const half = Math.ceil(vehicle.silhouette / 2);
        return { difficulty: Math.max(vehicle.speed, half), upgrades: Math.min(vehicle.speed, half) };
    }
    function damageSeverity(current, threshold) { if (current > threshold)
        return 4; if (current > threshold / 2)
        return 3; if (current === threshold / 2)
        return 2; return 1; }
    function damageControlDifficulty(vehicle) { validateVehicle(vehicle); return Math.max(damageSeverity(vehicle.systemStrain, vehicle.systemStrainThreshold), damageSeverity(vehicle.hullDamage, vehicle.hullThreshold)); }
    function applyDamageControl(vehicle, { successes = 0, operator = null } = {}) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        const s = int(successes, 'Êxitos', { min: 0, max: 99 });
        const tuneUp = operator ? (0, talents_mjs_1.talentRankByOriginal)(operator, 'FINETUN') : 0;
        const efficientRepair = operator ? (0, talents_mjs_1.talentRankByOriginal)(operator, 'SOLREP') : 0;
        const next = clone(vehicle);
        const beforeStrain = next.systemStrain, beforeHull = next.hullDamage;
        next.systemStrain = Math.max(0, next.systemStrain - (s + tuneUp));
        next.hullDamage = Math.max(0, next.hullDamage - (s + efficientRepair));
        return { vehicle: next, systemStrainRecovered: beforeStrain - next.systemStrain, hullRecovered: beforeHull - next.hullDamage, talentBonuses: { systemStrain: tuneUp, hull: efficientRepair } };
    }
    function applyVehicleCritical(vehicle, { roll = null, rng = Math.random, modifier = 0, component = null, defenseZone = 'proa', inAtmosphere = false, currentRound = 0 } = {}) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        if (!FACING_KEYS.includes(defenseZone))
            throw new Error('Zona de Defesa inválida.');
        const next = clone(vehicle);
        const rawRoll = roll === null ? Math.floor(Math.max(0, Math.min(0.999999999999, Number(rng()))) * 100) + 1 : int(roll, 'Rolagem de Critical Hit', { min: 1, max: 100 });
        const existing = unrepairedVehicleCriticalCount(next);
        const externalModifier = Math.trunc(Number(modifier) || 0);
        const total = rawRoll + (existing * 10) + externalModifier;
        let row = vehicleCriticalResult(total);
        if (row.key === 'major_hull_breach' && inAtmosphere)
            row = exports.VEHICLE_CRITICAL_HIT_TABLE.find(x => x.key === 'destabilized');
        const currentStatus = vehicleStatus(next, { currentRound });
        const number = next.criticalHits.length + 1;
        const hit = {
            number, key: row.key, title: row.title, severity: row.severity, repairDifficulty: row.repairDifficulty,
            rawRoll, existingCriticalModifier: existing * 10, externalModifier, total,
            effect: '', repaired: false, effectExpired: false, component: component ?? null, defenseZone,
            source: 'EOTE_CORE_TABLE_7_9'
        };
        let requiresComponentChoice = false;
        switch (row.key) {
            case 'mechanical_stress':
                next.systemStrain += 1;
                hit.effect = 'Sofre imediatamente 1 de Tensão de sistemas.';
                break;
            case 'jostled':
                hit.crewStrain = 1;
                hit.crewDisorientedRounds = 1;
                hit.effect = 'Toda a tripulação sofre 1 de Tensão e fica Desorientada por 1 assalto.';
                break;
            case 'losing_power_to_shields': {
                const noDefense = Object.values(currentStatus.defense).every(v => v <= 0);
                hit.fallbackSystemStrain = noDefense;
                if (noDefense)
                    next.systemStrain += 1;
                hit.effect = noDefense ? 'Sem Defesa ativa: sofre 1 de Tensão de sistemas.' : `Defesa em ${defenseZone} reduzida em 1 até reparo.`;
                break;
            }
            case 'knocked_off_course':
                hit.effectExpiresAfterRound = Number(currentRound) + 1;
                hit.pilotRecoveryDifficulty = Math.max(0, Number(vehicle.speed) || 0);
                hit.effect = 'No próximo turno, o piloto não executa manobras até recuperar o curso com Pilotagem.';
                break;
            case 'tailspin':
                hit.effectExpiresAfterRound = Number(currentRound) + 1;
                hit.crewDisorientedRounds = 1;
                hit.effect = 'Disparos sofrem 2 Contratempos até o fim do próximo turno do piloto; tripulação fica Desorientada por 1 assalto.';
                break;
            case 'component_hit':
                requiresComponentChoice = !component;
                hit.effectExpiresAfterRound = Number(currentRound) + 1;
                hit.effect = component ? `Componente temporariamente inoperante: ${component}.` : 'O atacante deve escolher um componente, inoperante até o fim do próximo assalto.';
                break;
            case 'shields_failing': {
                const noDefense = Object.values(currentStatus.defense).every(v => v <= 0);
                hit.fallbackSystemStrain = noDefense;
                if (noDefense)
                    next.systemStrain += 2;
                hit.effect = noDefense ? 'Sem Defesa ativa: sofre 2 de Tensão de sistemas.' : 'Defesa de todas as zonas reduzida em 1 até reparo.';
                break;
            }
            case 'hyperdrive_nav_failure':
                hit.effect = vehicle.hyperdrive ? 'Hiperimpulsor/computador de navegação falha: saltos ao hiperespaço bloqueados até reparo.' : 'Sistemas de navegação falham até reparo.';
                break;
            case 'power_fluctuations':
                hit.effect = 'O piloto não pode infligir Tensão de sistemas voluntariamente até reparo.';
                break;
            case 'shields_down': {
                const noDefense = Object.values(currentStatus.defense).every(v => v <= 0);
                hit.fallbackSystemStrain = noDefense;
                if (noDefense)
                    next.systemStrain += 4;
                hit.effect = noDefense ? 'Sem Defesa ativa: sofre 4 de Tensão de sistemas.' : `Defesa em ${defenseZone} cai a 0; demais zonas perdem 1 até reparo.`;
                break;
            }
            case 'engine_damaged':
                hit.effect = 'Velocidade máxima reduzida em 1, até o mínimo de 1, até reparo.';
                break;
            case 'shield_overload': {
                const noDefense = Object.values(currentStatus.defense).every(v => v <= 0);
                hit.armorFallback = noDefense;
                next.systemStrain += 2;
                hit.repairAfterEncounter = true;
                hit.effect = noDefense ? 'Sofre 2 de Tensão de sistemas e Blindagem -1 até reparo.' : 'Defesa de todas as zonas cai a 0 e sofre 2 de Tensão de sistemas; reparo só após o encontro.';
                break;
            }
            case 'engines_down':
                hit.effect = 'Velocidade máxima efetiva 0; nenhuma manobra até reparo; mantém o curso e a velocidade atuais.';
                break;
            case 'major_system_failure':
                requiresComponentChoice = !component;
                hit.effect = component ? `Componente inoperante até reparo: ${component}.` : 'O atacante deve escolher um componente, inoperante até reparo.';
                break;
            case 'major_hull_breach':
                hit.depressurizeRounds = Math.max(1, Number(vehicle.silhouette) || 1);
                hit.effect = vehicle.silhouette <= 4 ? `A nave despressuriza completamente em ${hit.depressurizeRounds} assalto(s).` : `Compartimentos atingidos despressurizam em ${hit.depressurizeRounds} assalto(s), a critério do Mestre.`;
                break;
            case 'destabilized':
                hit.effect = 'Limiar de Danos no casco e Limiar de Tensão de sistemas reduzidos à metade até reparo.';
                break;
            case 'fire':
                next.systemStrain += 2;
                hit.fireRounds = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Number(vehicle.silhouette) / 2));
                hit.effect = `Incêndio: sofre 2 de Tensão de sistemas; extinguir leva ${hit.fireRounds} assalto(s) com perícia apropriada.`;
                break;
            case 'breaking_up':
                hit.destroyAfterRound = Number(currentRound) + 1;
                hit.effect = 'A nave será destruída ao fim do próximo assalto; tripulação tem um assalto para escapar.';
                break;
            case 'vaporized':
                hit.destroyed = true;
                hit.effect = 'Nave/veículo completamente destruído; nada sobrevive.';
                break;
        }
        next.criticalHits.push(hit);
        return { vehicle: next, hit, requiresComponentChoice, status: vehicleStatus(next, { currentRound }), table: 'EOTE_CORE_TABLE_7_9' };
    }
    function repairVehicleCritical(vehicle, index, { encounterEnded = true } = {}) {
        validateVehicle(vehicle);
        const next = clone(vehicle);
        const i = int(index, 'Índice do Critical Hit', { min: 0, max: next.criticalHits.length - 1 });
        const hit = next.criticalHits[i];
        if (!hit)
            throw new Error('Critical Hit inexistente.');
        if (hit.repaired)
            return next;
        if (hit.key === 'vaporized' || hit.destroyed)
            throw new Error('Uma nave vaporizada/destruída não pode ser reparada.');
        if (hit.repairAfterEncounter && !encounterEnded)
            throw new Error('Este Critical Hit só pode ser reparado após o fim do encontro.');
        hit.repaired = true;
        hit.effectExpired = true;
        return next;
    }
    function upgradePositivePool(pool, upgrades = 0) {
        let ability = Math.max(0, Number(pool?.ability ?? 0)), proficiency = Math.max(0, Number(pool?.proficiency ?? 0));
        let n = Math.max(0, Number(upgrades) || 0);
        while (n-- > 0) {
            if (ability > 0) {
                ability -= 1;
                proficiency += 1;
            }
            else
                ability += 1;
        }
        return { ability, proficiency };
    }
    function upgradeDifficultyPool(difficulty, challenge = 0, upgrades = 0) {
        let d = Math.max(0, Number(difficulty) || 0), c = Math.max(0, Number(challenge) || 0), n = Math.max(0, Number(upgrades) || 0);
        while (n-- > 0) {
            if (d > 0) {
                d -= 1;
                c += 1;
            }
            else
                d += 1;
        }
        return { difficulty: d, challenge: c };
    }
    function vehicleAttackPool({ character, attacker, target, targetOperator = null, facing = 'proa', weaponIndex = 0, targetRange = 'Bocajarro', rng = Math.random, extraBoost = 0, extraSetback = 0 } = {}) {
        validateVehicle(attacker);
        validateVehicle(target);
        if (!character)
            throw new Error('Atacante sem personagem/operador.');
        const weapon = attacker.weapons?.[weaponIndex];
        if (!weapon)
            throw new Error('Arma de veículo inválida.');
        if (vehicleStatus(attacker).weaponsOnline === false)
            throw new Error('As armas estão offline por sobrecarga dos sistemas.');
        if (rangeIndex(targetRange) > rangeIndex(weapon.range))
            throw new Error(`Alvo fora do alcance desta arma (${weapon.range}).`);
        const rank = Number(character.skills?.[weapon.skill] ?? 0), characteristic = Number(character.characteristics?.agilidad ?? 0);
        const positiveUpgrades = (attacker.roundEffects?.stayOnTarget ? 1 : 0) + (target.roundEffects?.stayOnTarget ? 1 : 0);
        const positive = upgradePositivePool((0, narrativeDice_mjs_1.buildPositivePool)(characteristic, rank), positiveUpgrades);
        const pilotedTargetSilhouette = targetOperator ? (0, talents_mjs_1.talentPilotedVehicleSilhouette)(targetOperator, target.silhouette) : target.silhouette;
        const controlledFireBonus = attacker.roundEffects?.controlledFire ? 1 : 0;
        const targetSilhouette = Math.min(10, pilotedTargetSilhouette + controlledFireBonus);
        const baseDifficulty = gunneryDifficultyBySilhouette(attacker.silhouette, targetSilhouette);
        const difficultyUpgrades = (attacker.roundEffects?.evasive ? 1 : 0) + (target.roundEffects?.evasive ? 1 : 0);
        const negative = upgradeDifficultyPool(baseDifficulty, 0, difficultyUpgrades);
        const targetDefense = defenseValue(vehicleStatus(target, { operator: targetOperator }).defense?.[facing]);
        const boost = Number(extraBoost);
        const setback = Number(extraSetback) + targetDefense + Number(vehicleStatus(attacker).firingSetback ?? 0);
        const check = (0, narrativeDice_mjs_1.rollPool)({ ...positive, ...negative, boost, setback }, rng);
        const hit = check.success;
        const nonDamage = Boolean(weapon.nonDamage);
        const damage = hit && !nonDamage ? Number(weapon.damage ?? 0) + check.netSuccess : 0;
        const criticalAvailable = hit && !nonDamage && Number.isFinite(Number(weapon.crit)) && (check.netAdvantage >= Number(weapon.crit) || check.triumph > 0);
        const specialEffect = hit && Number(weapon.qualities?.tractor ?? 0) > 0 ? { type: 'tractor', rating: Number(weapon.qualities.tractor), sourceId: attacker.id } : null;
        return { weapon, check, hit, damage, nonDamage, specialEffect, breach: Number(weapon.qualities?.breach ?? 0), criticalAvailable, criticalCost: weapon.crit, difficulty: negative.difficulty, challenge: negative.challenge, baseDifficulty, targetDefense, targetRange, targetSilhouette, pilotedTargetSilhouette, controlledFireBonus, positiveUpgrades, difficultyUpgrades };
    }
    function resolveVehicleWeaponAttack(args = {}) {
        const attack = vehicleAttackPool(args);
        if (!attack.hit)
            return { ...attack, targetDamage: null, targetEffect: null };
        if (attack.specialEffect?.type === 'tractor') {
            const vehicle = applyTractorLock(args.target, { rating: attack.specialEffect.rating, sourceId: attack.specialEffect.sourceId });
            return { ...attack, targetDamage: null, targetEffect: { type: 'tractor', rating: attack.specialEffect.rating, vehicle } };
        }
        const targetDamage = applyVehicleScaleDamage(args.target, { damage: attack.damage, breach: attack.breach });
        return { ...attack, targetDamage, targetEffect: null };
    }
    function createVehicleRuntime() { return { schemaVersion: 1, activeVehicleId: null, vehicles: {}, combat: { active: false, round: 0, targetVehicleId: null, range: 'Curto', actionUsed: false, maneuversUsed: 0, lastAttack: null, log: [] } }; }
    function normalizeVehicleRuntime(value) {
        const base = createVehicleRuntime();
        const next = { ...base, ...clone(value ?? {}), vehicles: { ...(value?.vehicles ?? {}) }, combat: { ...base.combat, ...clone(value?.combat ?? {}) } };
        for (const [id, raw] of Object.entries(next.vehicles)) {
            const v = { ...raw, criticalHits: Array.isArray(raw?.criticalHits) ? raw.criticalHits : [], disabledComponents: Array.isArray(raw?.disabledComponents) ? raw.disabledComponents : [], tractorLocks: Array.isArray(raw?.tractorLocks) ? raw.tractorLocks : [], roundEffects: { evasive: false, stayOnTarget: false, enfiladeTargetId: null, controlledFire: false, ...(raw?.roundEffects ?? {}) } };
            next.vehicles[id] = v;
            try {
                validateVehicle(v);
            }
            catch {
                delete next.vehicles[id];
            }
        }
        if (next.activeVehicleId && !next.vehicles[next.activeVehicleId])
            next.activeVehicleId = null;
        if (next.combat.targetVehicleId && !next.vehicles[next.combat.targetVehicleId])
            next.combat.targetVehicleId = null;
        return next;
    }

    function resolveWeaponHit(weapon, check) {
        if (!weapon || typeof weapon !== 'object')
            throw new Error('Arma inválida.');
        if (!check || typeof check !== 'object')
            throw new Error('Resultado de ataque inválido.');
        const damage = Number(weapon.damage);
        if (!Number.isInteger(damage) || damage < 0)
            throw new Error('Dano da arma inválido.');
        if (!check.success) {
            return {
                hit: false,
                damage: 0,
                criticalAvailable: false,
                blastAvailable: false,
                weapon: structuredClone(weapon),
                check
            };
        }
        const netSuccess = Math.max(0, Number(check.netSuccess) || 0);
        const netAdvantage = Math.max(0, Number(check.netAdvantage) || 0);
        return {
            hit: true,
            damage: damage + netSuccess,
            pierce: Number(weapon.pierce ?? 0),
            damageType: weapon.damageType ?? 'wounds',
            criticalAvailable: Number.isInteger(weapon.crit) ? (Number(check.triumph ?? 0) > 0 || netAdvantage >= weapon.crit) : false,

            blastDamage: Number.isInteger(weapon.blast) ? weapon.blast + netSuccess : null,

    function simulateDay(w, d, day) {
        for (const [id, npc] of Object.entries(w.npcs || {})) {
            const s = d.npcs[id];
            if (!s || s.lifeState !== 'alive')
                continue;
            s.currentActivity = activity(npc, day);
            const locState = d.locations[npc.locationId];
            let delta = (roll(id + ':wealth:' + day, 7) - 3);
            if (s.occupation === 'comércio')
                delta += 1;
            if (locState?.marketPressure > 65 && s.occupation !== 'comércio')
                delta -= 1;
            if (locState?.marketPressure > 65 && s.occupation === 'comércio')
                delta += 1;
            const beforeTier = s.wealthTier;
            s.wealthIndex = clamp(s.wealthIndex + delta, 0, 100);
            s.wealthTier = wealthTier(s.wealthIndex);
            if (beforeTier !== s.wealthTier)
                remember(s, { tick: w.clock?.tick, kind: 'wealth', summary: `A condição econômica de ${npc.name} passou de ${beforeTier} para ${s.wealthTier}.`, importance: 55 });
            const routes = routesFrom(w, npc.locationId);
            if (routes.length && roll(id + ':move:' + day, 100) < 18) {
                const r = routes[roll(id + ':route:' + day, routes.length)];
                const from = npc.locationId;
                npc.locationId = r.toLocationId;
                s.lastLocationId = npc.locationId;
                remember(s, { tick: w.clock?.tick, kind: 'travel', summary: `${npc.name} saiu de ${w.locations?.[from]?.name || from} e foi para ${w.locations?.[npc.locationId]?.name || npc.locationId}.`, importance: 40 });
            }
            updateNpcSocialGraph(w, d, day, npc, s);
            advanceCommitments(s, day);
            const dangerous = /ca[cç]ador|seguran[cç]a|contraband/.test(norm(s.occupation + ' ' + (npc.tags || []).join(' ')));
            const age = s.ageYears;
            const deathThreshold = age >= 85 ? 0.6 : age >= 75 ? 0.18 : (dangerous ? 0.015 : 0.003);
            const r = roll(id + ':mortality:' + day, 10000) / 100;
            if (r < deathThreshold) {
                s.lifeState = 'dead';
                npc.status = 'dead';
                s.currentActivity = 'falecido';
                remember(s, { tick: w.clock?.tick, kind: 'life', summary: `${npc.name} morreu fora de cena durante a evolução autônoma do mundo.`, importance: 100 });
            }
            s.lastSimulatedTick = w.clock?.tick || 0;
        }
        for (const [id, loc] of Object.entries(w.locations || {})) {
            const s = d.locations[id];
            if (!s)
                continue;
            s.weather = weatherKind(loc, day);
            s.supply = clamp(s.supply + (roll(id + ':supply:' + day, 5) - 2), 0, 100);
            s.demand = clamp(s.demand + (roll(id + ':demand:' + day, 5) - 2), 0, 100);
            s.security = clamp(s.security + (roll(id + ':security:' + day, 3) - 1), 0, 100);
            s.routeAccess = clamp(s.routeAccess + (roll(id + ':routeaccess:' + day, 3) - 1), 0, 100);
            s.marketPressure = clamp(50 + (s.demand - s.supply) / 2 + (50 - s.security) / 4 + (50 - s.routeAccess) / 4, 0, 100);
            s.lastSimulatedTick = w.clock?.tick || 0;

            s.lastSimulatedTick = w.clock?.tick || 0;
        }
        advancePublishedAdventurePlans(w, d, day);
    }

    function normalizeWorld(value) {
        const base = createWorld();
        const src = value && typeof value === 'object' ? clone(value) : {};
        const next = {
            ...base, ...src,

            factions: { ...(src.factions ?? {}) },
            clock: { ...base.clock, ...(src.clock ?? {}) },
            events: Array.isArray(src.events) ? src.events : [],
            hooks: Array.isArray(src.hooks) ? src.hooks : [],
            aftermaths: Array.isArray(src.aftermaths) ? src.aftermaths : [],
            encounterHistory: Array.isArray(src.encounterHistory) ? src.encounterHistory : [],
            history: Array.isArray(src.history) ? src.history : []

        next.policy = clone(WORLD_POLICY_SOURCE);
        for (const [id, npc0] of Object.entries(next.npcs)) {
            if (!npc0 || typeof npc0 !== 'object') {

            }
            const npc = { ...npc0, id: npc0.id ?? id };
            npc.name = String(npc.name ?? 'PNPC').trim() || 'PNPC';

            npc.factionId = npc.factionId ?? null;
            npc.goal = String(npc.goal ?? npc.objective ?? '').trim();
            npc.relation = String(npc.relation ?? npc.relationship ?? 'neutral').trim() || 'neutral';

            delete npc.objective;

        }
        for (const [id, loc0] of Object.entries(next.locations)) {
            if (!loc0 || typeof loc0 !== 'object') {

                continue;
            }
            next.locations[id] = { id: loc0.id ?? id, name: String(loc0.name ?? id), description: String(loc0.description ?? ''), knownToPlayer: Boolean(loc0.knownToPlayer), tags: Array.isArray(loc0.tags) ? loc0.tags.map(String) : [] };
        }
        for (const [id, faction0] of Object.entries(next.factions)) {
            const faction = normalizeFaction(faction0, id);
            if (!faction) {
                delete next.factions[id];
                continue;
            }
            next.factions[id] = faction;
        }
        for (const npc of Object.values(next.npcs)) {
            if (npc.factionId && !next.factions[npc.factionId])
                npc.factionId = null;
        }

                if (!next.factions[targetId])
                    delete faction.relations[targetId];

        return next;
    }
    function removeFactionResource(world, factionId, resource) {
        const next = normalizeWorld(world);
        const f = next.factions[factionId];
        if (!f)
            throw new Error('Facção não encontrada.');
        const clean = text(resource, 'Recurso da facção', { required: true, max: 160 });
        const i = f.resources.indexOf(clean);
        if (i < 0)
            throw new Error('Recurso da facção não encontrado.');
        f.resources.splice(i, 1);
        f.updatedAt = nowIso();
        return next;
    }
    function setFactionRelation(world, factionId, targetFactionId, relation) {
        const next = normalizeWorld(world);
        const f = next.factions[factionId];
        const target = next.factions[targetFactionId];
        if (!f || !target)
            throw new Error('Facção não encontrada.');
        if (factionId === targetFactionId)
            throw new Error('Uma facção não pode ter relação consigo mesma.');
        f.relations[targetFactionId] = text(relation, 'Relação entre facções', { required: true, max: 120 });
        f.updatedAt = nowIso();
        return next;
    }
    function recordFactionFact(world, factionId, { text: factText, knownToPlayer = false } = {}) {
        const next = normalizeWorld(world);
        const f = next.factions[factionId];
        if (!f)
            throw new Error('Facção não encontrada.');
        const clean = text(factText, 'Fato da facção', { required: true, max: 1000 });
        f.facts.push({ id: (0, ids_mjs_1.newId)('ffact'), text: clean, knownToPlayer: Boolean(knownToPlayer) });
        f.updatedAt = nowIso();
        return next;
    }
    function createFactionPlan(world, factionId, { title, objective = '', steps = [], knownToPlayer = false } = {}) {
        const next = normalizeWorld(world);
        const faction = next.factions[factionId];
        if (!faction)
            throw new Error('Facção não encontrada.');
        const cleanTitle = text(title, 'Título do plano', { required: true, max: 160 });
        if (!Array.isArray(steps) || steps.length < 1 || steps.length > 20)
            throw new Error('O plano da facção exige de 1 a 20 etapas.');
        const normalizedSteps = steps.map((step, index) => {
            const src = typeof step === 'string' ? { text: step } : step;
            if (!src || typeof src !== 'object')
                throw new Error(`Etapa ${index + 1} do plano inválida.`);
            const locationId = src.locationId ? String(src.locationId) : null;
            if (locationId && !next.locations[locationId])
                throw new Error(`Local não encontrado na etapa do plano: ${locationId}`);
            return { id: (0, ids_mjs_1.newId)('fstep'), text: text(src.text, 'Etapa do plano', { required: true, max: 300 }), status: 'planned', locationId, knownToPlayer: Boolean(src.knownToPlayer), order: index };
        });
        const plan = normalizeFactionPlan({ id: (0, ids_mjs_1.newId)('fplan'), title: cleanTitle, objective: text(objective, 'Objetivo do plano', { max: 500 }), status: 'planned', steps: normalizedSteps, knownToPlayer: Boolean(knownToPlayer), updatedAt: nowIso() });
        faction.plans.push(plan);
        faction.updatedAt = nowIso();
        return { world: next, plan: clone(plan) };
    }
    function setFactionPlanStatus(world, factionId, planId, status) {
        const next = normalizeWorld(world);
        const faction = next.factions[factionId];
        if (!faction)
            throw new Error('Facção não encontrada.');
        const plan = faction.plans.find(p => p.id === planId);
        if (!plan)
            throw new Error('Plano da facção não encontrado.');
        if (!FACTION_PLAN_STATUSES.has(status))
            throw new Error('Estado do plano da facção inválido.');
        if (plan.status === 'completed' || plan.status === 'aborted')
            throw new Error('Plano encerrado não pode mudar de estado.');
        if (plan.status === 'active' && status === 'planned')
            throw new Error('Plano ativo não pode voltar a planejado.');
        plan.status = status;
        if (status === 'active' && !plan.steps.some(s => s.status === 'active')) {
            const first = plan.steps.find(s => s.status === 'planned');
            if (first)
                first.status = 'active';
        }
        if (status === 'completed')
            for (const step of plan.steps)
                if (step.status === 'planned' || step.status === 'active')
                    step.status = 'skipped';
        if (status === 'aborted')
            for (const step of plan.steps)
                if (step.status === 'planned' || step.status === 'active')
                    step.status = 'skipped';
        plan.updatedAt = nowIso();
        faction.updatedAt = nowIso();
        return next;
    }
    function advanceFactionPlan(world, factionId, planId) {
        const next = normalizeWorld(world);
        const faction = next.factions[factionId];
        if (!faction)
            throw new Error('Facção não encontrada.');
        const plan = faction.plans.find(p => p.id === planId);
        if (!plan)
            throw new Error('Plano da facção não encontrado.');
        if (plan.status === 'completed' || plan.status === 'aborted')
            throw new Error('Plano encerrado não pode avançar.');
        if (plan.status === 'planned') {
            plan.status = 'active';
            const first = plan.steps.find(s => s.status === 'planned');
            if (first)
                first.status = 'active';
            plan.updatedAt = nowIso();
            faction.updatedAt = nowIso();
            return { world: next, plan: clone(plan), completedStep: null, nextStep: clone(first ?? null) };
        }
        const active = plan.steps.find(s => s.status === 'active');
        if (!active)
            throw new Error('Plano ativo sem etapa ativa.');
        active.status = 'completed';
        const following = plan.steps.find(s => s.status === 'planned');
        if (following)
            following.status = 'active';
        else
            plan.status = 'completed';
        plan.updatedAt = nowIso();
        faction.updatedAt = nowIso();
        return { world: next, plan: clone(plan), completedStep: clone(active), nextStep: clone(following ?? null) };
    }
    function playerVisibleFaction(faction) {
        const copy = clone(faction);
        copy.facts = (copy.facts ?? []).filter(f => f.knownToPlayer);
        copy.plans = (copy.plans ?? []).filter(p => p.knownToPlayer).map(p => ({ ...p, steps: (p.steps ?? []).filter(s => s.knownToPlayer || s.status === 'completed') }));
        return copy;
    }
    function setNpcFaction(world, npcId, factionId = null) {
        const next = normalizeWorld(world);
        if (!next.npcs[npcId])
            throw new Error('PNPC não encontrado.');
        if (factionId && !next.factions[factionId])
            throw new Error('Facção não encontrada.');
        next.npcs[npcId].factionId = factionId || null;
        next.npcs[npcId].updatedAt = nowIso();
        return next;
    }
    function createNpc({ name, locationId = null, factionId = null, goal = '', relation = 'neutral', status = 'active', knownToPlayer = false, tags = [], species = '', sex = '', gender = '', origin = '', career = '', specialization = '', occupation = '', ageYears = null, appearance = '' } = {}) {
        const cleanName = text(name, 'Nome do PNPC', { required: true, max: 120 });
        const id = (0, ids_mjs_1.newId)('npc');
        const profile = normalizeNpcProfile({ id, name: cleanName, species, sex, gender, origin, career, specialization, occupation, ageYears, appearance });
        return { id, name: cleanName, ...profile, locationId, factionId, goal: text(goal, 'Objetivo do PNPC', { max: 500 }), relation: text(relation, 'Relação', { max: 80 }) || 'neutral', status: text(status, 'Estado', { max: 80 }) || 'active', knownToPlayer: Boolean(knownToPlayer), facts: [], tags: Array.isArray(tags) ? tags.map(v => String(v).trim()).filter(Boolean) : [], combatState: null, updatedAt: nowIso() };
    }
    function upsertNpc(world, npc) {
        if (!npc?.id)
            throw new Error('PNPC sem ID estável.');
        const next = normalizeWorld(world);
        next.npcs[npc.id] = clone(npc);
        return next;
    }

    }

    function recordNpcFact(world, npcId, { text: factText, knownToPlayer = false } = {}) {

        if (!next.npcs[npcId])
            throw new Error('PNPC não encontrado.');
        next.npcs[npcId].facts.push({ id: (0, ids_mjs_1.newId)('fact'), text: clean, knownToPlayer: Boolean(knownToPlayer) });
        next.npcs[npcId].updatedAt = nowIso();
        return next;
    }
    function playerVisibleNpc(npc) {
        const copy = clone(npc);
        copy.facts = (copy.facts ?? []).filter(f => f.knownToPlayer);
        return copy;
    }
    function normalizeEvent(event) {
        if (!event || typeof event !== 'object')
            return null;
        const dueTick = Math.max(0, Number(event.dueTick) || 0);
        return { id: event.id ?? (0, ids_mjs_1.newId)('wevt'), type: String(event.type ?? ''), dueTick, payload: clone(event.payload ?? {}), status: ['pending', 'done', 'failed', 'cancelled'].includes(event.status) ? event.status : 'pending', dedupeKey: event.dedupeKey ? String(event.dedupeKey) : null, createdAt: event.createdAt ?? nowIso(), executedAtTick: event.executedAtTick ?? null, error: event.error ?? null, source: event.source ?? clone(WORLD_POLICY_SOURCE) };
    }
    function scheduleWorldEvent(world, { type, dueTick, payload = {}, dedupeKey = null } = {}) {
        const next = normalizeWorld(world);
        const cleanType = text(type, 'Tipo de evento', { required: true, max: 80 });
        const tick = int(dueTick, 'Tick do evento', { min: next.clock.tick });
        const key = dedupeKey ? text(dedupeKey, 'Chave de deduplicação', { required: true, max: 160 }) : null;
        if (key) {
            const existing = next.events.find(e => e.dedupeKey === key && e.status !== 'cancelled');
            if (existing)
                return { world: next, event: clone(existing), created: false };
        }
        const event = normalizeEvent({ id: (0, ids_mjs_1.newId)('wevt'), type: cleanType, dueTick: tick, payload, dedupeKey: key, status: 'pending', createdAt: nowIso(), source: clone(WORLD_POLICY_SOURCE) });
        next.events.push(event);
        return { world: next, event: clone(event), created: true };
    }
    function cancelWorldEvent(world, eventId) {
        const next = normalizeWorld(world);
        const event = next.events.find(e => e.id === eventId);
        if (!event)
            throw new Error('Evento de mundo não encontrado.');
        if (event.status === 'done')
            throw new Error('Evento já executado não pode ser cancelado.');
        event.status = 'cancelled';
        return next;
    }
    function applyWorldEvent(world, event) {
        let next = world;
        const p = event.payload ?? {};
        const factionEvent = event.type.startsWith('set_faction_') || event.type === 'add_faction_resource' || event.type === 'remove_faction_resource' || event.type === 'record_faction_fact' || event.type === 'advance_faction_plan';
        if (factionEvent && p.locationId && !next.locations?.[p.locationId])
            throw new Error(`Local não encontrado para evento de facção: ${p.locationId}`);
        if (event.type === 'move_npc')
            next = moveNpc(next, String(p.npcId ?? ''), p.locationId ?? null);
        else if (event.type === 'set_npc_goal')
            next = setNpcGoal(next, String(p.npcId ?? ''), p.goal ?? '');
        else if (event.type === 'set_npc_relation')
            next = setNpcRelation(next, String(p.npcId ?? ''), p.relation ?? 'neutral');
        else if (event.type === 'set_npc_status')
            next = setNpcStatus(next, String(p.npcId ?? ''), p.status ?? 'active');
        else if (event.type === 'record_npc_fact')
            next = recordNpcFact(next, String(p.npcId ?? ''), { text: p.text, knownToPlayer: Boolean(p.knownToPlayer) });
        else if (event.type === 'set_npc_faction')
            next = setNpcFaction(next, String(p.npcId ?? ''), p.factionId ?? null);
        else if (event.type === 'set_faction_objective')
            next = setFactionObjective(next, String(p.factionId ?? ''), p.objective ?? '');
        else if (event.type === 'set_faction_status')
            next = setFactionStatus(next, String(p.factionId ?? ''), p.status ?? 'active');
        else if (event.type === 'add_faction_resource')
            next = addFactionResource(next, String(p.factionId ?? ''), p.resource ?? '');
        else if (event.type === 'remove_faction_resource')
            next = removeFactionResource(next, String(p.factionId ?? ''), p.resource ?? '');
        else if (event.type === 'set_faction_relation')
            next = setFactionRelation(next, String(p.factionId ?? ''), String(p.targetFactionId ?? ''), p.relation ?? '');
        else if (event.type === 'record_faction_fact')
            next = recordFactionFact(next, String(p.factionId ?? ''), { text: p.text, knownToPlayer: Boolean(p.knownToPlayer) });
        else if (event.type === 'advance_faction_plan')
            next = advanceFactionPlan(next, String(p.factionId ?? ''), String(p.planId ?? '')).world;
        else
            throw new Error(`Tipo de evento de mundo não suportado: ${event.type}`);
        return next;
    }
    function hookSummaryForEvent(world, event) {
        const p = event.payload ?? {};
        const npcId = String(p.npcId ?? '');
        const npc = npcId ? world.npcs?.[npcId] ?? null : null;
        const factionId = String(p.factionId ?? '');
        const faction = factionId ? world.factions?.[factionId] ?? null : null;
        const planForEvent = event.type === 'advance_faction_plan' && faction ? faction.plans?.find(x => x.id === String(p.planId ?? '')) : null;
        const activePlanStep = planForEvent?.steps?.find(x => x.status === 'active') ?? null;
        const locationId = npc?.locationId ?? (p.locationId && world.locations?.[p.locationId] ? String(p.locationId) : null) ?? (activePlanStep?.locationId && world.locations?.[activePlanStep.locationId] ? activePlanStep.locationId : null);
        const location = locationId ? world.locations?.[locationId] : null;
        let summary = '';
        if (event.type === 'move_npc' && npc)
            summary = `${npc.name} chegou a ${location?.name ?? locationId ?? 'um destino não identificado'}.`;
        else if (event.type === 'set_npc_goal' && npc)
            summary = `${npc.name} mudou de objetivo: ${npc.goal || 'sem objetivo definido'}.`;
        else if (event.type === 'set_npc_relation' && npc)
            summary = `${npc.name} agora mantém relação ${npc.relation}.`;
        else if (event.type === 'set_npc_status' && npc)
            summary = `${npc.name} mudou de estado para ${npc.status}.`;
        else if (event.type === 'record_npc_fact' && npc)
            summary = `Um novo fato persistente foi registrado para ${npc.name}.`;
        else if (event.type === 'set_npc_faction' && npc)
            summary = `${npc.name} agora está ligado à facção ${world.factions?.[npc.factionId]?.name ?? 'nenhuma'}.`;
        else if (event.type === 'set_faction_objective' && faction)
            summary = `${faction.name} mudou de objetivo: ${faction.objective || 'sem objetivo definido'}.`;
        else if (event.type === 'set_faction_status' && faction)
            summary = `${faction.name} mudou de estado para ${faction.status}.`;
        else if (event.type === 'add_faction_resource' && faction)
            summary = `${faction.name} passou a dispor de ${String(p.resource ?? 'um novo recurso')}.`;
        else if (event.type === 'remove_faction_resource' && faction)
            summary = `${faction.name} deixou de dispor de ${String(p.resource ?? 'um recurso')}.`;
        else if (event.type === 'set_faction_relation' && faction)
            summary = `A relação de ${faction.name} com ${world.factions?.[p.targetFactionId]?.name ?? p.targetFactionId ?? 'outra facção'} mudou para ${String(p.relation ?? '')}.`;
        else if (event.type === 'record_faction_fact' && faction)
            summary = `Um novo fato persistente foi registrado para a facção ${faction.name}.`;
        else if (event.type === 'advance_faction_plan' && faction) {
            const plan = faction.plans?.find(x => x.id === String(p.planId ?? ''));
            const active = plan?.steps?.find(x => x.status === 'active');
            summary = plan?.status === 'completed' ? `${faction.name} concluiu o plano ${plan.title}.` : `${faction.name} avançou o plano ${plan?.title ?? 'em andamento'}${active ? `: ${active.text}` : ''}.`;
        }
        if (!summary)
            return null;
        return normalizeHook({
            id: (0, ids_mjs_1.newId)('whook'), kind: faction ? 'faction_consequence' : 'world_consequence', sourceEventId: event.id, npcId: npc?.id ?? null, factionId: faction?.id ?? null, planId: event.type === 'advance_faction_plan' ? String(p.planId ?? '') || null : null, locationId,
            summary, status: 'pending', dedupeKey: `event:${event.id}`, createdAtTick: world.clock.tick, source: clone(WORLD_POLICY_SOURCE)
        });
    }
    function appendHookFromEvent(world, event) {
        const next = normalizeWorld(world);
        const hook = hookSummaryForEvent(next, event);
        if (!hook)
            return { world: next, hook: null, created: false };
        if (next.hooks.some(h => h.dedupeKey === hook.dedupeKey))
            return { world: next, hook: null, created: false };
        next.hooks.push(hook);
        return { world: next, hook: clone(hook), created: true };
    }
    function resolveWorldHook(world, hookId, { resolution = '', dismiss = false } = {}) {
        const next = normalizeWorld(world);
        const hook = next.hooks.find(h => h.id === hookId);
        if (!hook)
            throw new Error('Consequência do mundo não encontrada.');
        if (hook.status !== 'pending')
            throw new Error('Essa consequência do mundo já foi resolvida.');
        hook.status = dismiss ? 'dismissed' : 'resolved';
        hook.resolvedAtTick = next.clock.tick;
        hook.resolution = text(resolution, 'Resolução da consequência', { max: 800 }) || null;
        next.history.push({ id: (0, ids_mjs_1.newId)('whist'), hookId: hook.id, type: 'resolve_world_hook', tick: next.clock.tick, status: hook.status, resolution: hook.resolution });
        return next;
    }
    function recordEncounterOutcome(world, { hookId = null, outcome, summary = '', rounds = 0, adversaries = [] } = {}) {
        const next = normalizeWorld(world);
        const cleanOutcome = text(outcome, 'Desfecho do encontro', { required: true, max: 80 });
        const hook = hookId ? next.hooks.find(h => h.id === hookId) : null;
        if (hookId && !hook)
            throw new Error('Consequência causal do encontro não encontrada.');
        const existing = hookId ? next.encounterHistory.find(e => e.hookId === hookId) : null;
        if (existing)
            return { world: next, encounter: clone(existing), created: false };
        const record = normalizeEncounterRecord({
            id: (0, ids_mjs_1.newId)('wenc'), hookId: hook?.id ?? null, factionId: hook?.factionId ?? null, planId: hook?.planId ?? null, locationId: hook?.locationId ?? null,
            outcome: cleanOutcome, summary: text(summary, 'Resumo do encontro', { max: 1000 }), rounds: int(rounds, 'Rodadas do encontro', { min: 0, max: 100000 }),
            adversaries, createdAtTick: next.clock.tick, source: clone(WORLD_POLICY_SOURCE)
        });
        next.encounterHistory.push(record);
        let after = null;
        if (hook) {
            after = normalizeAftermath({
                id: (0, ids_mjs_1.newId)('waft'), hookId: hook.id, encounterId: record.id, factionId: record.factionId, planId: record.planId, locationId: record.locationId,
                outcome: record.outcome, summary: record.summary || `Encontro encerrado com desfecho ${record.outcome}.`, status: 'active', knownToPlayer: true, createdAtTick: next.clock.tick, source: clone(WORLD_POLICY_SOURCE)
            });
            next.aftermaths.push(after);
        }
        next.history.push({ id: (0, ids_mjs_1.newId)('whist'), type: 'record_encounter_outcome', tick: next.clock.tick, encounterId: record.id, hookId: hook?.id ?? null, outcome: record.outcome, aftermathId: after?.id ?? null });
        return { world: next, encounter: clone(record), aftermath: after ? clone(after) : null, created: true };
    }
    function closeWorldAftermath(world, aftermathId, { resolution = '' } = {}) {
        const next = normalizeWorld(world);
        const item = next.aftermaths.find(a => a.id === aftermathId);
        if (!item)
            throw new Error('Consequência de longo prazo não encontrada.');
        if (item.status !== 'active')
            throw new Error('Essa consequência de longo prazo já foi encerrada.');
        item.status = 'closed';
        item.closedAtTick = next.clock.tick;
        item.resolution = text(resolution, 'Resolução da consequência de longo prazo', { max: 1000 }) || null;
        next.history.push({ id: (0, ids_mjs_1.newId)('whist'), type: 'close_aftermath', tick: next.clock.tick, aftermathId: item.id, resolution: item.resolution });
        return next;
    }
    function activeWorldAftermaths(world, { limit = 50, knownOnly = false } = {}) {
        const w = normalizeWorld(world);
        const max = int(limit, 'Limite de consequências de longo prazo', { min: 1, max: 200 });
        return w.aftermaths.filter(a => a.status === 'active' && (!knownOnly || a.knownToPlayer)).sort((a, b) => a.createdAtTick - b.createdAtTick || String(a.id).localeCompare(String(b.id))).slice(0, max).map(clone);
    }
    function causalEncounterCandidates(world, locationId, { limit = 12 } = {}) {
        const w = normalizeWorld(world);
        if (!locationId)
            return [];
        const max = int(limit, 'Limite de consequências', { min: 1, max: 50 });
        const hooks = w.hooks.filter(h => h.status === 'pending' && h.locationId === locationId).sort((a, b) => a.createdAtTick - b.createdAtTick || String(a.id).localeCompare(String(b.id)));
        return hooks.slice(0, max).map(h => {
            const npc = h.npcId ? w.npcs[h.npcId] : null;
            const faction = h.factionId ? w.factions[h.factionId] : null;
            return { hookId: h.id, sourceEventId: h.sourceEventId, planId: h.planId ?? null, locationId: h.locationId, summary: h.summary, npc: npc ? { id: npc.id, name: npc.name, goal: npc.goal, relation: npc.relation, status: npc.status, factionId: npc.factionId ?? null } : null, faction: faction ? { id: faction.id, name: faction.name, objective: faction.objective, status: faction.status } : null, source: clone(WORLD_POLICY_SOURCE) };
        });
    }
    function advanceWorld(world, { ticks = 1, maxEvents = 50 } = {}) {
        let next = normalizeWorld(world);
        const delta = int(ticks, 'Avanço do mundo', { min: 0, max: 100000 });
        const budget = int(maxEvents, 'Orçamento de eventos', { min: 1, max: 1000 });
        next.clock.tick += delta;
        const due = next.events.filter(e => e.status === 'pending' && e.dueTick <= next.clock.tick).sort((a, b) => a.dueTick - b.dueTick || String(a.id).localeCompare(String(b.id)));
        const processed = [];
        const hooksCreated = [];
        let used = 0;
        for (const dueEvent of due) {
            if (used >= budget)
                break;
            const index = next.events.findIndex(e => e.id === dueEvent.id);
            if (index < 0)
                continue;
            try {
                next = applyWorldEvent(next, next.events[index]);
                const current = next.events.find(e => e.id === dueEvent.id);
                current.status = 'done';
                current.executedAtTick = next.clock.tick;
                current.error = null;
                const hooked = appendHookFromEvent(next, current);
                next = hooked.world;
                if (hooked.created && hooked.hook)
                    hooksCreated.push(hooked.hook);
                next.history.push({ id: (0, ids_mjs_1.newId)('whist'), eventId: dueEvent.id, type: dueEvent.type, tick: next.clock.tick, status: 'done', hookId: hooked.hook?.id ?? null });
                processed.push({ eventId: dueEvent.id, type: dueEvent.type, status: 'done', hookId: hooked.hook?.id ?? null });
            }
            catch (error) {
                const current = next.events.find(e => e.id === dueEvent.id);
                current.status = 'failed';
                current.executedAtTick = next.clock.tick;
                current.error = String(error?.message ?? error);
                next.history.push({ id: (0, ids_mjs_1.newId)('whist'), eventId: dueEvent.id, type: dueEvent.type, tick: next.clock.tick, status: 'failed', error: current.error });
                processed.push({ eventId: dueEvent.id, type: dueEvent.type, status: 'failed', error: current.error });
            }
            used += 1;
        }
        const pendingDue = next.events.filter(e => e.status === 'pending' && e.dueTick <= next.clock.tick).length;
        return { world: next, processed, hooksCreated, pendingDue, tick: next.clock.tick, budgetUsed: used };
    }
